title: ADA Analytical Parameter Value Registry
description: Registry of reusable schema:PropertyValue parameter-value definitions derived from technique TAPP spreadsheets. Each $def constrains one per-dataset schema:PropertyValue entry. Detail building blocks reference these definitions via fragment $refs (schema.yaml#/$defs/<name>) so they resolve locally through the building-block register. The root only hosts $defs; it has no instantiable properties of its own.

empa_acceleratingVoltage.title: Accelerating Voltage
empa_acceleratingVoltage.description: Electron beam accelerating voltage in kilovolts (kV). Justify any deviation from the standard operating voltage.

empa_analyteEstimationMethod.title: Analyte Estimation Method
empa_analyteEstimationMethod.description: Whether elemental concentrations were calculated directly from measured X-ray intensities, or estimated by cation stoichiometry (e.g., oxygen calculated from cation proportions in silicates; carbon from stoichiometry in carbonates).

empa_backgroundCountingTime.title: Background Counting Time
empa_backgroundCountingTime.description: Total time spent counting at off-peak background position(s) in seconds, summed across all background positions.

empa_backgroundPosition.title: Background Position(s)
empa_backgroundPosition.description: Location(s) of off-peak background measurement(s) relative to the peak, in mm or sin-theta, and whether on the high- or low-energy side.

empa_beamCurrent.title: Beam Current
empa_beamCurrent.description: Probe current in nanoamperes (nA). Often varies by phase type or analyte; record the procedure-standard value(s).

empa_beamDamageMinimization.title: Beam Damage Minimization
empa_beamDamageMinimization.description: Measures taken to minimize beam damage, particularly volatilization or migration of Na, K, F, and Cl in hydrous minerals, glasses, feldspars, phosphates, and carbonates. Document approach, beam conditions used, and phases for which it was applied.

empa_beamDiameter.title: Beam Diameter
empa_beamDiameter.description: Diameter of the electron beam in micrometers. 0 indicates a fully focused beam. Document defocused diameter when used to minimize beam damage or improve spatial averaging for beam-sensitive phases.

empa_beamRasterDimensions.title: Beam Raster Dimensions
empa_beamRasterDimensions.description: Dimensions of the small area over which the beam is rastered at a single analysis point, reported as width × height in µm. Applicable when Beam Mode = Rastered; defines the effective spatial footprint of the measurement. Not applicable when mapping.

empa_blankCorrection.title: Blank Correction
empa_blankCorrection.description: Method and reference material(s) used to determine and subtract blank signal contributions (e.g., carbon coat contribution to C signal, or background contamination for trace elements).

empa_calibrationFactorAndDeterminationMe.title: Calibration Factor and Determination Method
empa_calibrationFactorAndDeterminationMe.description: An externally-calibrated factor that converts the measured quantity into the reported quantity, how it was determined, and its uncertainty. Applies where the conversion depends on a factor calibrated against a reference of independently known value, rather than on the instrument response alone. Distinct from the fields that name the calibration material and that state which approach applies to which analyte, where the technique has them: this field records the resulting factor itself.

empa_constantsAndReferenceValuesUsed.title: Constants and Reference Values Used
empa_constantsAndReferenceValuesUsed.description: Physical constants and reference values used in data reduction to calculate the final reported quantity (e.g., decay constants for age calculation, standard isotope ratios, or other citable reference values used in a correction or calculation), together with their source. Distinct from the Group 6 reference-material fields, which document accepted values for specific calibration/validation materials rather than universal physical constants. Record "None" if no citable, revisable physical constants feed into this procedure's data reduction.

empa_coupledDatasetOrPublicationReferenc.title: Coupled Dataset or Publication Reference
empa_coupledDatasetOrPublicationReferenc.description: DOI or other persistent identifier for the co-registered dataset or publication where both datasets are reported together. Accepts: a dedicated dataset DOI (if separately deposited), a shared dataset DOI (if co-submitted in the same package), or a publication DOI. Use "same submission" if the coupled dataset is included in this data package, or "pending" if not yet assigned. If coupling is documented through a shared sample identifier only, that information is already captured in Sample Persistent Identifier (Group 2).

empa_coupledProcedureDoi.title: Coupled Procedure DOI
empa_coupledProcedureDoi.description: Registered procedure DOI for the coupled technique named above. If the coupled procedure has not yet been registered, enter the DOI of a publication describing the coupled method, or "pending". Enter "None" if no coupling is planned.

empa_dataProcessingSoftware.title: Data Processing Software(s)
empa_dataProcessingSoftware.description: All software applied to the data after acquisition in order to produce the reported quantities, including version numbers. List every package used. Distinct from Acquisition Software, which controls the instrument and collects the raw data.

empa_driftCorrection.title: Drift Correction
empa_driftCorrection.description: Method used to monitor and correct for instrument drift (beam current drift, spectrometer drift) during the analytical session.

empa_dwellTimePerPixel.title: Dwell Time per Pixel
empa_dwellTimePerPixel.description: Time spent acquiring X-ray signal at each pixel during X-ray mapping, in milliseconds. For WDS: one value per spectrometer assignment per pixel. For EDS: total live-time per spectrum per pixel, a single value.

empa_edsDetectorConfiguration.title: EDS Detector Configuration
empa_edsDetectorConfiguration.description: EDS detector type, manufacturer, number of detector elements, active area and solid angle, window type, and geometry (take-off angle, position). List multiple detectors separately. Record 'N/A' where the procedure has no EDS detector.

empa_edsLiveTimePerPointOrPixel.title: EDS Live Time per Point or Pixel
empa_edsLiveTimePerPointOrPixel.description: EDS spectral acquisition live time per analysis point in seconds. Previously referred to as "EDS Acquisition Time" in this TAPP and commonly used under that name in EPMA and SEM-EDS contexts. Renamed to align with TEM-EDS usage, where the per-point vs. per-pixel distinction (point/line mode vs. spectrum image) is explicit. In EPMA, acquisition is always per point.

schema:name.const: EDS Live Time per Point or Pixel

empa_edsSpectralProcessingType.title: EDS Spectral Processing Type
empa_edsSpectralProcessingType.description: Method used to process EDS spectra and extract net peak intensities from raw spectral data. Applied before quantification (see Matrix Correction Method). Common approaches include background fitting and subtraction followed by peak integration, and filter fit or Gaussian deconvolution for overlapping peaks.

empa_halogenCorrectionOnOxygen.title: Halogen Correction on Oxygen
empa_halogenCorrectionOnOxygen.description: Whether oxygen content was adjusted to account for halogen substitution (F and/or Cl replacing OH) in halogen-bearing phases such as apatite, amphibole, and mica, where oxygen is calculated by stoichiometry.

empa_interferenceCorrectionStandard.title: Interference Correction Standard
empa_interferenceCorrectionStandard.description: Reference material used to quantify and calibrate the interference correction.

empa_interferingElements.title: Interfering Elements
empa_interferingElements.description: Element(s) whose X-ray lines overlap with the measured peak, requiring a correction.

empa_normalizationStandardsBasedCorrecti.title: Normalization / Standards-Based Correction
empa_normalizationStandardsBasedCorrecti.description: Post-acquisition normalization applied to the reported data beyond the primary calibration — for example correction to a reference value derived from secondary reference materials, or correction for a systematic bias those materials reveal. Record 'None' if no additional normalization is applied.

empa_peakCountingTime.title: Peak Counting Time
empa_peakCountingTime.description: Time spent counting X-ray intensity at the peak position, in seconds. Adjustments stay within procedure-defined bounds.

empa_preAnalysisImagingAndScreening.title: Pre-Analysis Imaging and Screening
empa_preAnalysisImagingAndScreening.description: Imaging or other characterisation performed before the measurement in order to select or locate the sampling unit to be analysed, including the technique, instrument and settings used, and how individual analyses are linked back to the images. Distinct from any imaging the procedure performs as its own measurement. Where the imaging is performed on a separate instrument, it should also be recorded in the Group 1 coupling fields.

empa_primaryCalibrationStandardName.title: Primary Calibration Standard Name
empa_primaryCalibrationStandardName.description: Name and reference material identifier of the primary reference material(s) against which the instrument is calibrated — converting raw signal intensities to concentrations, or anchoring an isotope ratio as the bracketing standard or zero-delta reference. Give the material name, its source or supplier, and a citation for the accepted values used. Where calibration instead uses the vendor's stored library or theoretical response factors rather than measured reference materials — 'standardless' or 'semi-quantitative' quantification — record that here, naming the library or model used. 'None' means no calibration was performed at all, which is a different answer.

empa_samplePersistentIdentifier.title: Sample Persistent Identifier
empa_samplePersistentIdentifier.description: Globally unique, persistent identifier for each sample listed in Sample Name. IGSN (International Geo Sample Number) is the recommended standard for geological and cosmochemical samples, as used by Astromat, EarthChem and SESAR. Where a sample and its sub-samples are separately registered, record the identifier at the level actually analysed.

empa_samplePreparationMethod.title: Sample Preparation Method
empa_samplePreparationMethod.description: The form in which the sample is presented to the instrument, and the preparation that brought it to that form — for example mounting, sectioning, polishing, coating, crushing, fusion, or extraction of an electron-transparent section. Record 'None' where the material is analysed as received.

empa_samplingUnitSelectionCriteria.title: Sampling Unit Selection Criteria
empa_samplingUnitSelectionCriteria.description: The rules governing which sampling unit(s) within a sample are selected for analysis, and why. Covers the criteria applied when choosing grains, aliquots, spots, or a region of interest — size, morphology, clarity, freedom from inclusions or alteration, phase identity, or spatial position. Distinct from Target Material, which states the material type the procedure is designed for, and from Sampling Unit, which names the kind of subdivision one row of reported values corresponds to: this field states how, within such a sample, the unit actually analysed is picked out.

empa_secondaryReferenceMaterials.title: Secondary Reference Materials
empa_secondaryReferenceMaterials.description: Quality-control reference material(s) measured as unknowns alongside samples to assess accuracy independently and to monitor drift. Give the material name, its source, and a citation for the accepted or reference values used for comparison.

empa_sequence.title: Sequence
empa_sequence.description: Order in which spectrometer assignments are acquired during point analysis. Not applicable to X-ray mapping, where all assigned spectrometers collect simultaneously at each pixel.

empa_stageScanVsBeamScan.title: Stage Scan vs. Beam Scan
empa_stageScanVsBeamScan.description: For mapping modes, whether the map was acquired by moving the stage while the beam is held fixed (stage scan), or by deflecting the beam across the field while the stage is stationary (beam scan).

empa_stepSizePixelSize.title: Step Size / Pixel Size
empa_stepSizePixelSize.description: Distance between adjacent measurement points in the X-ray map in micrometers, defining the spatial resolution. Report both X and Y step if they differ.

empa_timeDependentIntensityCorrection.title: Time-Dependent Intensity Correction
empa_timeDependentIntensityCorrection.description: Type of time-dependent intensity (TDI) correction applied to compensate for beam-induced volatilization or migration of sensitive elements (e.g., Na, K, F in glasses, feldspars, carbonates).

empa_wdsPhaSetting.title: WDS PHA Setting
empa_wdsPhaSetting.description: Pulse height analyzer (PHA) setting for the WDS detector. Integral mode accepts all pulses above a threshold; Differential mode selects a narrow energy window to reject higher-order reflections and escape peaks.

empa_wdsSpectrometerChannel.title: WDS Spectrometer Channel
empa_wdsSpectrometerChannel.description: WDS spectrometer position(s) assigned to each analyte, one entry per assignment. An analyte may be assigned to more than one spectrometer with intensities aggregated (aggregate intensity counting), and one spectrometer serves several analytes across a run, so the assignment — not the analyte — is the unit carrying the spectrometer setup.

empa_wdsSpectrometerConfiguration.title: WDS Spectrometer Configuration
empa_wdsSpectrometerConfiguration.description: Number, type, and crystal range of WDS spectrometers on the instrument. Include manufacturer, model, and crystal range. For SEM-WDS configurations (third-party WDS on a non-EPMA platform), include WDS manufacturer and model.

empa_xRayBackgroundCorrectionMethod.title: X-ray Background Correction Method
empa_xRayBackgroundCorrectionMethod.description: Method used to estimate and subtract background X-ray intensity beneath the peak. For WDS: typically 2-point off-peak linear interpolation or Mean Atomic Number (MAN) background model. For EDS: spectral background fitting or top-hat filter applied during spectral processing.

laMcicpmsUPb_ablationDurationPerSpot.title: Ablation Duration per Spot
laMcicpmsUPb_ablationDurationPerSpot.description: Total on-sample ablation (signal acquisition) time per individual spot in seconds, as set in the acquisition method. For transect analysis, the equivalent procedure-level parameter is scan speed (captured in Transect Rate, Mapping Rate or Step Size). For mapping analysis, total acquisition time is sample-area-dependent and is not captured here.

laMcicpmsUPb_ablationPitDepthAndAblation.title: Ablation Pit Depth and Ablation Rate
laMcicpmsUPb_ablationPitDepthAndAblation.description: Depth of the ablation pit produced under the registered laser conditions, the method used to measure it, and the resulting per-pulse ablation rate. For transect and mapping the equivalent quantity is trench depth under the same conditions.

schema:name.const: Ablation Pit Depth and Ablation Rate

laMcicpmsUPb_ageModel.title: Age Model
laMcicpmsUPb_ageModel.description: The statistical model used to combine individual analyses into a single reported age, including any criteria governing which model is applied. Record the model only — the software implementing it belongs in Data Reduction Software (Group 3), whose scope already extends to age calculation; where reduction and age regression use different packages, list both there.

laMcicpmsUPb_analysisSequence.title: Analysis Sequence
laMcicpmsUPb_analysisSequence.description: The repeating order in which calibration or bracketing standards, quality-control and secondary reference materials, blanks and unknowns are interleaved within a measurement session. Adjustments must maintain the bracketing strategy defined in the procedure.

laMcicpmsUPb_auxiliaryGasFlowRate.title: Auxiliary Gas Flow Rate
laMcicpmsUPb_auxiliaryGasFlowRate.description: Flow rate of the intermediate (auxiliary) argon gas stream, between the torch body and the injector tube, which positions the plasma relative to the load coil, in L/min. Distinct from the outer coolant (plasma) gas and from the gas stream that carries sample into the plasma.

laMcicpmsUPb_backgroundCountTime.title: Background Count Time
laMcicpmsUPb_backgroundCountTime.description: Total time spent measuring gas blank (background signal with laser off or shutter closed) before each ablation event, in seconds. For spot and transect analysis, a discrete background interval is measured before each ablation. For mapping, background is typically measured once per raster line or at the start of a map session rather than before each individual pixel.

laMcicpmsUPb_calibrationFactorAndDetermi.title: Calibration Factor and Determination Method
laMcicpmsUPb_calibrationFactorAndDetermi.description: An externally-calibrated factor that converts the measured quantity into the reported quantity, how it was determined, and its uncertainty. Applies where the conversion depends on a factor calibrated against a reference of independently known value, rather than on the instrument response alone. Distinct from the fields that name the calibration material and that state which approach applies to which analyte, where the technique has them: this field records the resulting factor itself.

laMcicpmsUPb_carrierGasAndFlowRate.title: Carrier Gas and Flow Rate
laMcicpmsUPb_carrierGasAndFlowRate.description: Gas used to transport ablated aerosol from the ablation cell to the ICP-MS torch, with the procedure-registered target flow rate(s). Adjustment during tuning stays within ±10% of the target.

laMcicpmsUPb_cellExitDiscriminationVolta.title: Cell Exit Discrimination Voltage
laMcicpmsUPb_cellExitDiscriminationVolta.description: Bias voltage applied at the collision/reaction cell exit to discriminate between analyte ions and low-energy polyatomic interferences in KED mode, in volts (V). Record 'None' if the cell is in STD mode, and 'N/A' where Collision/Reaction Cell (CRC) Configuration does not include KED or the instrument has no cell.

laMcicpmsUPb_collisionGasFlowRate.title: Collision Gas Flow Rate
laMcicpmsUPb_collisionGasFlowRate.description: Flow rate of the collision gas, typically He, introduced into the collision/reaction cell in KED mode, in mL/min. Record 'None' if the cell is in STD mode, and 'N/A' where Collision/Reaction Cell (CRC) Configuration does not include KED or the instrument has no cell.

laMcicpmsUPb_collisionReactionGasMixture.title: Collision/Reaction Gas Mixture Ratio
laMcicpmsUPb_collisionReactionGasMixture.description: Where the collision or reaction cell is supplied with a mixture of gases rather than a single gas, the identities and proportions of that mixture. Recorded separately from the gas identity. Record 'N/A' where a single gas is used.

laMcicpmsUPb_constantsAndReferenceValues.title: Constants and Reference Values Used
laMcicpmsUPb_constantsAndReferenceValues.description: Physical constants and reference values used in data reduction to calculate the final reported quantity (e.g., decay constants for age calculation, standard isotope ratios, or other citable reference values used in a correction or calculation), together with their source. Distinct from the Group 6 reference-material fields, which document accepted values for specific calibration/validation materials rather than universal physical constants. Record "None" if no citable, revisable physical constants feed into this procedure's data reduction.

laMcicpmsUPb_coolantGasFlowRate.title: Coolant (Plasma) Gas Flow Rate
laMcicpmsUPb_coolantGasFlowRate.description: Flow rate of the outer (coolant/plasma) argon gas stream that sustains the ICP plasma, in L/min.

laMcicpmsUPb_coupledDatasetOrPublication.title: Coupled Dataset or Publication Reference
laMcicpmsUPb_coupledDatasetOrPublication.description: DOI or other persistent identifier for the co-registered dataset or publication where both datasets are reported together. Accepts: a dedicated dataset DOI (if separately deposited), a shared dataset DOI (if co-submitted in the same package), or a publication DOI. Use "same submission" if the coupled dataset is included in this data package, or "pending" if not yet assigned. If coupling is documented through a shared sample identifier only, that information is already captured in Sample Persistent Identifier (Group 2).

laMcicpmsUPb_coupledProcedureDoi.title: Coupled Procedure DOI
laMcicpmsUPb_coupledProcedureDoi.description: Registered procedure DOI for the coupled technique named above. If the coupled procedure has not yet been registered, enter the DOI of a publication describing the coupled method, or "pending". Enter "None" if no coupling is planned.

laMcicpmsUPb_dataProcessingSoftware.title: Data Processing Software(s)
laMcicpmsUPb_dataProcessingSoftware.description: All software applied to the data after acquisition in order to produce the reported quantities, including version numbers. List every package used. Distinct from Acquisition Software, which controls the instrument and collects the raw data.

laMcicpmsUPb_discordanceDefinitionAndVal.title: Discordance Definition and Values
laMcicpmsUPb_discordanceDefinitionAndVal.description: How discordance between the 206Pb/238U, 207Pb/235U and 207Pb/206Pb chronometers is defined for this procedure, and the discordance values obtained. State the formula used. The rule for excluding discordant analyses, and how many were excluded, belong in Analysis Inclusion and Rejection Criteria.

laMcicpmsUPb_doubleSpikeMixingRatio.title: Double-Spike Mixing Ratio
laMcicpmsUPb_doubleSpikeMixingRatio.description: Target proportion of double-spike signal relative to total analyte signal in the spiked mixture, expressed as spike fraction (0–1) or spike:sample ratio. The optimum is analyte-system specific and is typically determined using the Double Spike Toolbox or equivalent. The achieved mixing ratio may deviate from the target within acceptable bounds (typically ±20% of optimal); the double-spike inversion corrects for actual mixing ratios. Record 'N/A' where the procedure does not use a double spike.

laMcicpmsUPb_doublyChargedSpeciesMonitor.title: Doubly-Charged Species Monitor
laMcicpmsUPb_doublyChargedSpeciesMonitor.description: The mass ratio monitored to estimate doubly-charged ion (M²⁺) formation during instrument tuning. The monitor species and the mass positions monitored should be stated explicitly. Analogous to Oxide Production Method and Threshold for oxide monitoring.

laMcicpmsUPb_doublyChargedSpeciesProduct.title: Doubly-Charged Species Production
laMcicpmsUPb_doublyChargedSpeciesProduct.description: Measured percentage of doubly-charged ion production for the monitored species at the time of instrument tuning. The acceptable threshold is typically <1% or <3%. Record both the threshold and the measured value.

laMcicpmsUPb_fusionFluxAndDilutionRatio.title: Fusion Flux and Dilution Ratio
laMcicpmsUPb_fusionFluxAndDilutionRatio.description: For procedures using fused glass, the flux type and sample:flux dilution ratio used to prepare the analytical glass.

laMcicpmsUPb_icpTuning.title: ICP Tuning
laMcicpmsUPb_icpTuning.description: Description of the approach used to optimise ICP plasma conditions prior to analysis, including the reference material used for tuning and the acceptance criteria (e.g., oxide production threshold, sensitivity targets, mass calibration).

laMcicpmsUPb_inheritedOrInitialSignalCor.title: Inherited or Initial Signal Correction
laMcicpmsUPb_inheritedOrInitialSignalCor.description: How any non-radiogenic, inherited or pre-existing component of the measured signal was accounted for, including the composition assumed, its source, and its uncertainty. Record 'None' where the measured quantity accumulates from zero and no such component exists.

laMcicpmsUPb_instrumentSensitivity.title: Instrument Sensitivity
laMcicpmsUPb_instrumentSensitivity.description: Instrument sensitivity achieved in the session, with the isotope or channel it was measured on and the conditions it applies to. May be expressed either as detected signal per unit concentration or per unit mass of analyte delivered — counts per second per ppb, volts per ppm, counts per picogram — or as useful yield, the percentage of sampled atoms ultimately detected as ions, with the method used to derive it cited. A sensitivity the procedure requires before analyses may begin belongs with the tuning acceptance criteria.

laMcicpmsUPb_instrumentSerialNumberOrLab.title: Instrument Serial Number or Lab Identifier
laMcicpmsUPb_instrumentSerialNumberOrLab.description: Serial number or laboratory-internal identifier for the specific instrument unit.

schema:name.const: Instrument Serial Number or Lab Identifier

laMcicpmsUPb_instrumentWarmUpSessionDura.title: Instrument Warm-up / Session Duration Limit
laMcicpmsUPb_instrumentWarmUpSessionDura.description: Minimum warm-up time required after plasma ignition before analyses begin, and any maximum session duration enforced to maintain stable operating conditions.

laMcicpmsUPb_integrationTimePerCycle.title: Integration Time per Cycle
laMcicpmsUPb_integrationTimePerCycle.description: Duration of signal integration per measurement cycle (seconds). Where different isotope channels use different integration schemes, record the time for each channel.

laMcicpmsUPb_intermediateDaughterDisequi.title: Intermediate Daughter Disequilibrium Correction
laMcicpmsUPb_intermediateDaughterDisequi.description: Correction for initial disequilibrium in intermediate daughter products of the U decay chains — principally 230Th, and where relevant 231Pa — together with the Th/U or Pa/U partitioning value assumed and its source. Record 'None' with a justification where no correction was applied.

laMcicpmsUPb_ionCounterDeadTime.title: Ion Counter Dead Time
laMcicpmsUPb_ionCounterDeadTime.description: Dead time of each ion-counting detector channel, used in the dead-time correction applied to high count rates. Distinct from pulse/analog cross-calibration, which relates the two detector modes rather than correcting counting losses within the pulse-counting mode.

laMcicpmsUPb_laserBeamEnergyProfile.title: Laser Beam Energy Profile
laMcicpmsUPb_laserBeamEnergyProfile.description: Spatial energy distribution of the laser beam at the sample surface, and whether a beam homogenizer is installed.

laMcicpmsUPb_laserEnergy.title: Laser Energy
laMcicpmsUPb_laserEnergy.description: Laser pulse energy in millijoules as set at the laser output or measured at the sample surface. Report only when the system displays energy directly. Laser fluence (J cm⁻²) is the preferred quantity and is captured in Laser Fluence (Energy Density).

laMcicpmsUPb_laserFluence.title: Laser Fluence (Energy Density)
laMcicpmsUPb_laserFluence.description: Laser pulse energy per unit area at the sample surface in J cm⁻², as registered by the procedure. If the system reports only as % of maximum output, include that value and note the system maximum where known.

laMcicpmsUPb_laserRepetitionRate.title: Laser Repetition Rate
laMcicpmsUPb_laserRepetitionRate.description: Laser pulse repetition rate in hertz registered by the procedure.

laMcicpmsUPb_laserSpotGeometry.title: Laser Spot Geometry
laMcicpmsUPb_laserSpotGeometry.description: Shape and dimensions of the laser ablation spot in micrometres registered by the procedure. For circular spots, report diameter; for square or rectangular spots, report width × length.

laMcicpmsUPb_makeUpGasAndFlowRate.title: Make-up Gas and Flow Rate
laMcicpmsUPb_makeUpGasAndFlowRate.description: Supplementary gas added to the sample-carrying stream between the sample introduction system and the plasma, with its identity and the procedure-registered target flow rate. Record any small nitrogen or hydrogen addition with its own flow, whose unit commonly differs from the make-up flow. Record 'None' explicitly where no supplementary gas is added, to distinguish it from not reported.

laMcicpmsUPb_massResolutionSetting.title: Mass Resolution Setting
laMcicpmsUPb_massResolutionSetting.description: Operating mass resolution of the mass analyser. Where the analyser permits selection, state the mode; where individual analytes are assigned to different modes, state each.

laMcicpmsUPb_matrixOffsetCorrection.title: Matrix Offset Correction (LIEF)
laMcicpmsUPb_matrixOffsetCorrection.description: Whether an empirical correction was applied to account for systematic differences in laser-induced elemental fractionation (LIEF) patterns between the external calibration standard and the sample matrix.

laMcicpmsUPb_memoryEffectMitigation.title: Memory Effect Mitigation
laMcicpmsUPb_memoryEffectMitigation.description: Procedure applied to identify and minimise carry-over of high-concentration or isotopically distinct material from a preceding measurement into the current one. Mitigation is applied primarily at measurement time, by allowing sufficient washout or rinse between successive introductions. At data processing level, record any flagging or exclusion of measurements where the required washout may not have been achieved.

laMcicpmsUPb_multiRunSequentialAnalysisD.title: Multi-Run Sequential Analysis Design
laMcicpmsUPb_multiRunSequentialAnalysisD.description: Whether the procedure uses a single acquisition pass or multiple sequential runs on the same sample location, each optimized for different analytical objectives. For multi-run designs, describe the number of runs, their purpose, key laser and instrument settings per run, and how outputs of one run feed into data reduction of another. Not applicable to raster mapping, where each spatial location is visited exactly once.

laMcicpmsUPb_normalizationStandardsBased.title: Normalization / Standards-Based Correction
laMcicpmsUPb_normalizationStandardsBased.description: Post-acquisition normalization applied to the reported data beyond the primary calibration — for example correction to a reference value derived from secondary reference materials, or correction for a systematic bias those materials reveal. Record 'None' if no additional normalization is applied.

laMcicpmsUPb_numberOfBlocksPerMeasuremen.title: Number of Blocks per Measurement
laMcicpmsUPb_numberOfBlocksPerMeasuremen.description: Number of measurement blocks acquired per sample or standard solution introduction. In MC-ICP-MS, data are structured as blocks of cycles; each block typically begins with a baseline (on-peak zero) measurement before the analytical cycles. Adjust for samples with low signal or where higher precision is required.

laMcicpmsUPb_numberOfCyclesPerBlock.title: Number of Cycles per Block
laMcicpmsUPb_numberOfCyclesPerBlock.description: Number of measurement cycles acquired per block. One cycle corresponds to a single set of simultaneous Faraday cup readings integrated for the duration specified in Integration Time per Cycle. Total integration time per sample = (Number of Cycles per Block) × (Integration Time per Cycle) × (Number of Blocks per Measurement).

laMcicpmsUPb_preAblationSurfaceTreatment.title: Pre-Ablation Surface Treatment
laMcicpmsUPb_preAblationSurfaceTreatment.description: Procedure applied immediately before each analysis to remove surface contamination or condition the sample surface. Distinct from general sample preparation. For spot analysis, pre-ablation pulses are discarded before signal acquisition begins. For mapping, this step is typically omitted.

laMcicpmsUPb_preAnalysisImagingAndScreen.title: Pre-Analysis Imaging and Screening
laMcicpmsUPb_preAnalysisImagingAndScreen.description: Imaging or other characterisation performed before the measurement in order to select or locate the sampling unit to be analysed, including the technique, instrument and settings used, and how individual analyses are linked back to the images. Distinct from any imaging the procedure performs as its own measurement. Where the imaging is performed on a separate instrument, it should also be recorded in the Group 1 coupling fields.

laMcicpmsUPb_primaryCalibrationStandardN.title: Primary Calibration Standard Name
laMcicpmsUPb_primaryCalibrationStandardN.description: Name and reference material identifier of the primary reference material(s) against which the instrument is calibrated — converting raw signal intensities to concentrations, or anchoring an isotope ratio as the bracketing standard or zero-delta reference. Give the material name, its source or supplier, and a citation for the accepted values used. Where calibration instead uses the vendor's stored library or theoretical response factors rather than measured reference materials — 'standardless' or 'semi-quantitative' quantification — record that here, naming the library or model used. 'None' means no calibration was performed at all, which is a different answer.

laMcicpmsUPb_rasterLineSpacing.title: Raster Line Spacing (Mapping Only)
laMcicpmsUPb_rasterLineSpacing.description: Distance between adjacent raster lines in a 2D elemental map, measured perpendicular to the scan direction, in micrometres. Applies to raster mapping only.

laMcicpmsUPb_reactionGasFlowRate.title: Reaction Gas Flow Rate
laMcicpmsUPb_reactionGasFlowRate.description: Flow rate of the reactive gas introduced into the dynamic reaction cell (DRC), in mL/min. Record 'None' if DRC mode is not used, and 'N/A' where Collision/Reaction Cell (CRC) Configuration does not include DRC or the instrument has no cell.

laMcicpmsUPb_reactionGasType.title: Reaction Gas Type
laMcicpmsUPb_reactionGasType.description: Type of reactive gas introduced into the cell for interference removal through ION-MOLECULE CHEMISTRY, either on-mass or by mass shift. Common reaction gases include NH₃ (e.g., for Fe, Ca, K isotopes), O₂ (e.g., for As, Ge, Te mass shift) and CH₄. The distinction from Collision Gas Type is the mechanism, not the gas: record a gas here when a reaction is intended. Record 'None' if no reactive gas is used, and 'N/A' where Collision/Reaction Cell (CRC) Configuration does not include a reaction mode or the instrument has no cell.

laMcicpmsUPb_reactionProductIonMassShift.title: Reaction Product Ion / Mass-Shift Transition
laMcicpmsUPb_reactionProductIonMassShift.description: Where a monitored mass is produced by a reaction in the collision/reaction cell, the precursor ion, the reagent gas and the product ion measured. Records the mass-shift chemistry relating the mass measured to the analyte it reports, which the monitored mass alone does not state. Record 'N/A' where the analyte is measured on its own mass.

laMcicpmsUPb_reportedDateType.title: Reported Date Type
laMcicpmsUPb_reportedDateType.description: The kind of date or age the procedure reports. Where more than one type is reported, list all, separated by semicolons.

laMcicpmsUPb_rfPower.title: RF Power
laMcicpmsUPb_rfPower.description: Radiofrequency forward power applied to the ICP, in watts.

laMcicpmsUPb_sampleFormAnalyticalSubstra.title: Sample Form / Analytical Substrate
laMcicpmsUPb_sampleFormAnalyticalSubstra.description: Physical form of the material as it enters the ablation cell. Variations that do not alter the analytical procedure (e.g., thin section vs. mount) are legitimate.

laMcicpmsUPb_samplePersistentIdentifier.title: Sample Persistent Identifier
laMcicpmsUPb_samplePersistentIdentifier.description: Globally unique, persistent identifier for each sample listed in Sample Name. IGSN (International Geo Sample Number) is the recommended standard for geological and cosmochemical samples, as used by Astromat, EarthChem and SESAR. Where a sample and its sub-samples are separately registered, record the identifier at the level actually analysed.

laMcicpmsUPb_samplePreparationMethod.title: Sample Preparation Method
laMcicpmsUPb_samplePreparationMethod.description: The form in which the sample is presented to the instrument, and the preparation that brought it to that form — for example mounting, sectioning, polishing, coating, crushing, fusion, or extraction of an electron-transparent section. Record 'None' where the material is analysed as received.

laMcicpmsUPb_samplerAndSkimmerConeMateri.title: Sampler and Skimmer Cone Material
laMcicpmsUPb_samplerAndSkimmerConeMateri.description: Material composition of the sampler and skimmer cones. State both sampler and skimmer materials; a single statement is acceptable where they are identical.

laMcicpmsUPb_samplingUnitSelectionCriter.title: Sampling Unit Selection Criteria
laMcicpmsUPb_samplingUnitSelectionCriter.description: The rules governing which sampling unit(s) within a sample are selected for analysis, and why. Covers the criteria applied when choosing grains, aliquots, spots, or a region of interest — size, morphology, clarity, freedom from inclusions or alteration, phase identity, or spatial position. Distinct from Target Material, which states the material type the procedure is designed for, and from Sampling Unit, which names the kind of subdivision one row of reported values corresponds to: this field states how, within such a sample, the unit actually analysed is picked out.

laMcicpmsUPb_secondaryReferenceMaterials.title: Secondary Reference Materials
laMcicpmsUPb_secondaryReferenceMaterials.description: Quality-control reference material(s) measured as unknowns alongside samples to assess accuracy independently and to monitor drift. Give the material name, its source, and a citation for the accepted or reference values used for comparison.

laMcicpmsUPb_signalSmoothing.title: Signal Smoothing
laMcicpmsUPb_signalSmoothing.description: Description of any signal smoothing device or approach installed between the ablation cell and the ICP-MS to reduce pulse-to-pulse signal variability. For mapping analyses, report "None" explicitly.

laMcicpmsUPb_spikeOutlierFilteringApproa.title: Spike / Outlier Filtering Approach
laMcicpmsUPb_spikeOutlierFilteringApproa.description: Criteria used to identify and exclude anomalous data - signal spikes, individual cycles, or whole replicate measurements - before the reported value is calculated. State where in the reduction sequence the filter is applied.

laMcicpmsUPb_torchDepth.title: Torch Depth
laMcicpmsUPb_torchDepth.description: Distance between the load coil and the sampling cone tip (mm), also called injector depth or torch position depending on the instrument manufacturer.

laMcicpmsUPb_torchType.title: Torch Type
laMcicpmsUPb_torchType.description: Type of plasma torch installed (e.g. standard quartz, high-matrix, low-flow).

laMcicpmsUPb_transectRateMappingRateOrSt.title: Transect Rate, Mapping Rate or Step Size
laMcicpmsUPb_transectRateMappingRateOrSt.description: For continuous line scan (transect) and raster mapping: the stage translation speed in µm s⁻¹. For mapping, the mapping rate (mm² h⁻¹) may be reported as an alternative when scan speed is session-variable. For stepped line profiles: the distance between successive spot positions in µm.

schema:name.const: Transect Rate, Mapping Rate or Step Size

laMcicpmsUPb_uncertaintyPropagationMetho.title: Uncertainty Propagation Method
laMcicpmsUPb_uncertaintyPropagationMetho.description: The approach used to propagate analytical uncertainty through the data reduction chain to the final reported value. State which sources are included in the propagation: counting statistics, calibration standard uncertainty, internal standard uncertainty, drift correction, and any systematic contributions. Distinct from Uncertainty Level, which states the convention at which the resulting uncertainty is quoted.

laMcicpms_ablationDurationPerSpot.title: Ablation Duration per Spot
laMcicpms_ablationDurationPerSpot.description: Total on-sample ablation (signal acquisition) time per individual spot in seconds, as set in the acquisition method. For transect analysis, the equivalent procedure-level parameter is scan speed (captured in Transect Rate, Mapping Rate or Step Size). For mapping analysis, total acquisition time is sample-area-dependent and is not captured here.

laMcicpms_ablationPitDepthAndAblationRat.title: Ablation Pit Depth and Ablation Rate
laMcicpms_ablationPitDepthAndAblationRat.description: Depth of the ablation pit produced under the registered laser conditions, the method used to measure it, and the resulting per-pulse ablation rate. For transect and mapping the equivalent quantity is trench depth under the same conditions.

schema:name.const: Ablation Pit Depth and Ablation Rate

laMcicpms_analysisSequence.title: Analysis Sequence
laMcicpms_analysisSequence.description: The repeating order in which calibration or bracketing standards, quality-control and secondary reference materials, blanks and unknowns are interleaved within a measurement session. Adjustments must maintain the bracketing strategy defined in the procedure.

laMcicpms_auxiliaryGasFlowRate.title: Auxiliary Gas Flow Rate
laMcicpms_auxiliaryGasFlowRate.description: Flow rate of the intermediate (auxiliary) argon gas stream, between the torch body and the injector tube, which positions the plasma relative to the load coil, in L/min. Distinct from the outer coolant (plasma) gas and from the gas stream that carries sample into the plasma.

laMcicpms_backgroundCountTime.title: Background Count Time
laMcicpms_backgroundCountTime.description: Total time spent measuring gas blank (background signal with laser off or shutter closed) before each ablation event, in seconds. For spot and transect analysis, a discrete background interval is measured before each ablation. For mapping, background is typically measured once per raster line or at the start of a map session rather than before each individual pixel.

laMcicpms_calibrationFactorAndDeterminat.title: Calibration Factor and Determination Method
laMcicpms_calibrationFactorAndDeterminat.description: An externally-calibrated factor that converts the measured quantity into the reported quantity, how it was determined, and its uncertainty. Applies where the conversion depends on a factor calibrated against a reference of independently known value, rather than on the instrument response alone. Distinct from the fields that name the calibration material and that state which approach applies to which analyte, where the technique has them: this field records the resulting factor itself.

laMcicpms_carrierGasAndFlowRate.title: Carrier Gas and Flow Rate
laMcicpms_carrierGasAndFlowRate.description: Gas used to transport ablated aerosol from the ablation cell to the ICP-MS torch, with the procedure-registered target flow rate(s). Adjustment during tuning stays within ±10% of the target.

laMcicpms_cellExitDiscriminationVoltage.title: Cell Exit Discrimination Voltage
laMcicpms_cellExitDiscriminationVoltage.description: Bias voltage applied at the collision/reaction cell exit to discriminate between analyte ions and low-energy polyatomic interferences in KED mode, in volts (V). Record 'None' if the cell is in STD mode, and 'N/A' where Collision/Reaction Cell (CRC) Configuration does not include KED or the instrument has no cell.

laMcicpms_collisionGasFlowRate.title: Collision Gas Flow Rate
laMcicpms_collisionGasFlowRate.description: Flow rate of the collision gas, typically He, introduced into the collision/reaction cell in KED mode, in mL/min. Record 'None' if the cell is in STD mode, and 'N/A' where Collision/Reaction Cell (CRC) Configuration does not include KED or the instrument has no cell.

laMcicpms_collisionReactionGasMixtureRat.title: Collision/Reaction Gas Mixture Ratio

laMcicpms_constantsAndReferenceValuesUse.title: Constants and Reference Values Used
laMcicpms_constantsAndReferenceValuesUse.description: Physical constants and reference values used in data reduction to calculate the final reported quantity (e.g., decay constants for age calculation, standard isotope ratios, or other citable reference values used in a correction or calculation), together with their source. Distinct from the Group 6 reference-material fields, which document accepted values for specific calibration/validation materials rather than universal physical constants. Record "None" if no citable, revisable physical constants feed into this procedure's data reduction.

laMcicpms_coolantGasFlowRate.title: Coolant (Plasma) Gas Flow Rate
laMcicpms_coolantGasFlowRate.description: Flow rate of the outer (coolant/plasma) argon gas stream that sustains the ICP plasma, in L/min.

laMcicpms_coupledDatasetOrPublicationRef.title: Coupled Dataset or Publication Reference

Accepts: a dedicated dataset DOI (if separately deposited), a shared dataset DOI (if co-submitted in the same package), or a publication DOI. Use "same submission" if the coupled dataset is included in this data package, or "pending" if not yet assigned. If coupling is documented through a shared sample identifier only, that information is already captured in Sample Persistent Identifier (Group 2).

laMcicpms_coupledProcedureDoi.title: Coupled Procedure DOI
laMcicpms_coupledProcedureDoi.description: Registered procedure DOI for the coupled technique named above. If the coupled procedure has not yet been registered, enter the DOI of a publication describing the coupled method, or "pending". Enter "None" if no coupling is planned.

laMcicpms_dataProcessingSoftware.title: Data Processing Software(s)
laMcicpms_dataProcessingSoftware.description: All software applied to the data after acquisition in order to produce the reported quantities, including version numbers. List every package used. Distinct from Acquisition Software, which controls the instrument and collects the raw data.

laMcicpms_doubleSpikeMixingRatio.title: Double-Spike Mixing Ratio
laMcicpms_doubleSpikeMixingRatio.description: Target proportion of double-spike signal relative to total analyte signal in the spiked mixture, expressed as spike fraction (0–1) or spike:sample ratio. The optimum is analyte-system specific and is typically determined using the Double Spike Toolbox or equivalent. The achieved mixing ratio may deviate from the target within acceptable bounds (typically ±20% of optimal); the double-spike inversion corrects for actual mixing ratios. Record 'N/A' where the procedure does not use a double spike.

laMcicpms_doublyChargedSpeciesMonitor.title: Doubly-Charged Species Monitor
laMcicpms_doublyChargedSpeciesMonitor.description: The mass ratio monitored to estimate doubly-charged ion (M²⁺) formation during instrument tuning. The monitor species and the mass positions monitored should be stated explicitly. Analogous to Oxide Production Method and Threshold for oxide monitoring.

laMcicpms_doublyChargedSpeciesProduction.title: Doubly-Charged Species Production
laMcicpms_doublyChargedSpeciesProduction.description: Measured percentage of doubly-charged ion production for the monitored species at the time of instrument tuning. The acceptable threshold is typically <1% or <3%. Record both the threshold and the measured value.

laMcicpms_fusionFluxAndDilutionRatio.title: Fusion Flux and Dilution Ratio
laMcicpms_fusionFluxAndDilutionRatio.description: For procedures using fused glass, the flux type and sample:flux dilution ratio used to prepare the analytical glass.

laMcicpms_icpTuning.title: ICP Tuning
laMcicpms_icpTuning.description: Description of the approach used to optimise ICP plasma conditions prior to analysis, including the reference material used for tuning and the acceptance criteria (e.g., oxide production threshold, sensitivity targets, mass calibration).

laMcicpms_instrumentSensitivity.title: Instrument Sensitivity
laMcicpms_instrumentSensitivity.description: Instrument sensitivity achieved in the session, with the isotope or channel it was measured on and the conditions it applies to. May be expressed either as detected signal per unit concentration or per unit mass of analyte delivered — counts per second per ppb, volts per ppm, counts per picogram — or as useful yield, the percentage of sampled atoms ultimately detected as ions, with the method used to derive it cited. A sensitivity the procedure requires before analyses may begin belongs with the tuning acceptance criteria.

laMcicpms_instrumentSerialNumberOrLabIde.title: Instrument Serial Number or Lab Identifier
laMcicpms_instrumentSerialNumberOrLabIde.description: Serial number or laboratory-internal identifier for the specific instrument unit.

schema:name.const: Instrument Serial Number or Lab Identifier

laMcicpms_instrumentWarmUpSessionDuratio.title: Instrument Warm-up / Session Duration Limit
laMcicpms_instrumentWarmUpSessionDuratio.description: Minimum warm-up time required after plasma ignition before analyses begin, and any maximum session duration enforced to maintain stable operating conditions.

laMcicpms_integrationTimePerCycle.title: Integration Time per Cycle
laMcicpms_integrationTimePerCycle.description: Duration of signal integration per measurement cycle (seconds). Where different isotope channels use different integration schemes, record the time for each channel.

laMcicpms_ionCounterDeadTime.title: Ion Counter Dead Time
laMcicpms_ionCounterDeadTime.description: Dead time of each ion-counting detector channel, used in the dead-time correction applied to high count rates. laMcicpms_laserBeamEnergyProfile.title: Laser Beam Energy Profile
laMcicpms_laserBeamEnergyProfile.description: Spatial energy distribution of the laser beam at the sample surface, and whether a beam homogenizer is installed.

laMcicpms_laserEnergy.title: Laser Energy
laMcicpms_laserEnergy.description: Laser pulse energy in millijoules as set at the laser output or measured at the sample surface. Report only when the system displays energy directly. Laser fluence (J cm⁻²) is the preferred quantity and is captured in Laser Fluence (Energy Density).

laMcicpms_laserFluence.title: Laser Fluence (Energy Density)
laMcicpms_laserFluence.description: Laser pulse energy per unit area at the sample surface in J cm⁻², as registered by the procedure. If the system reports only as % of maximum output, include that value and note the system maximum where known.

laMcicpms_laserRepetitionRate.title: Laser Repetition Rate
laMcicpms_laserRepetitionRate.description: Laser pulse repetition rate in hertz registered by the procedure.

laMcicpms_laserSpotGeometry.title: Laser Spot Geometry
laMcicpms_laserSpotGeometry.description: Shape and dimensions of the laser ablation spot in micrometres registered by the procedure. For circular spots, report diameter; for square or rectangular spots, report width × length.

laMcicpms_makeUpGasAndFlowRate.title: Make-up Gas and Flow Rate
laMcicpms_makeUpGasAndFlowRate.description: Supplementary gas added to the sample-carrying stream between the sample introduction system and the plasma, with its identity and the procedure-registered target flow rate. Record any small nitrogen or hydrogen addition with its own flow, whose unit commonly differs from the make-up flow. Record 'None' explicitly where no supplementary gas is added, to distinguish it from not reported.

laMcicpms_massResolutionSetting.title: Mass Resolution Setting

laMcicpms_matrixOffsetCorrection.title: Matrix Offset Correction (LIEF)
laMcicpms_matrixOffsetCorrection.description: Whether an empirical correction was applied to account for systematic differences in laser-induced elemental fractionation (LIEF) patterns between the external calibration standard and the sample matrix.

laMcicpms_memoryEffectMitigation.title: Memory Effect Mitigation
laMcicpms_memoryEffectMitigation.description: Procedure applied to identify and minimise carry-over of high-concentration or isotopically distinct material from a preceding measurement into the current one. Mitigation is applied primarily at measurement time, by allowing sufficient washout or rinse between successive introductions. At data processing level, record any flagging or exclusion of measurements where the required washout may not have been achieved.

laMcicpms_multiRunSequentialAnalysisDesi.title: Multi-Run Sequential Analysis Design
laMcicpms_multiRunSequentialAnalysisDesi.description: Whether the procedure uses a single acquisition pass or multiple sequential runs on the same sample location, each optimized for different analytical objectives. For multi-run designs, describe the number of runs, their purpose, key laser and instrument settings per run, and how outputs of one run feed into data reduction of another. laMcicpms_normalizationStandardsBasedCor.title: Normalization / Standards-Based Correction
laMcicpms_normalizationStandardsBasedCor.description: Post-acquisition normalization applied to the reported data beyond the primary calibration — for example correction to a reference value derived from secondary reference materials, or correction for a systematic bias those materials reveal. Record 'None' if no additional normalization is applied.

laMcicpms_numberOfBlocksPerMeasurement.title: Number of Blocks per Measurement
laMcicpms_numberOfBlocksPerMeasurement.description: Number of measurement blocks acquired per sample or standard solution introduction. In MC-ICP-MS, data are structured as blocks of cycles; each block typically begins with a baseline (on-peak zero) measurement before the analytical cycles. Adjust for samples with low signal or where higher precision is required.

laMcicpms_numberOfCyclesPerBlock.title: Number of Cycles per Block
laMcicpms_numberOfCyclesPerBlock.description: Number of measurement cycles acquired per block. One cycle corresponds to a single set of simultaneous Faraday cup readings integrated for the duration specified in Integration Time per Cycle. Total integration time per sample = (Number of Cycles per Block) × (Integration Time per Cycle) × (Number of Blocks per Measurement).

laMcicpms_preAblationSurfaceTreatment.title: Pre-Ablation Surface Treatment
laMcicpms_preAblationSurfaceTreatment.description: Procedure applied immediately before each analysis to remove surface contamination or condition the sample surface. laMcicpms_preAnalysisImagingAndScreening.title: Pre-Analysis Imaging and Screening
laMcicpms_preAnalysisImagingAndScreening.description: Imaging or other characterisation performed before the measurement in order to select or locate the sampling unit to be analysed, including the technique, instrument and settings used, and how individual analyses are linked back to the images. laMcicpms_primaryCalibrationStandardName.title: Primary Calibration Standard Name
laMcicpms_primaryCalibrationStandardName.description: Name and reference material identifier of the primary reference material(s) against which the instrument is calibrated — converting raw signal intensities to concentrations, or anchoring an isotope ratio as the bracketing standard or zero-delta reference. Give the material name, its source or supplier, and a citation for the accepted values used. Where calibration instead uses the vendor's stored library or theoretical response factors rather than measured reference materials — 'standardless' or 'semi-quantitative' quantification — record that here, naming the library or model used. laMcicpms_rasterLineSpacing.title: Raster Line Spacing (Mapping Only)

laMcicpms_reactionGasFlowRate.title: Reaction Gas Flow Rate

laMcicpms_reactionGasType.title: Reaction Gas Type
