laQicpmsUPb_collisionGasFlowRate.title: Collision Gas Flow Rate
laQicpmsUPb_collisionGasFlowRate.description: Flow rate of the collision gas, typically He, introduced into the collision/reaction cell in KED mode, in mL/min. Record 'None' if the cell is in STD mode, and 'N/A' where Collision/Reaction Cell (CRC) Configuration does not include KED or the instrument has no cell.

laQicpmsUPb_collisionReactionGasMixtureR.title: Collision/Reaction Gas Mixture Ratio
laQicpmsUPb_collisionReactionGasMixtureR.description: Where the collision or reaction cell is supplied with a mixture of gases rather than a single gas, the identities and proportions of that mixture. Recorded separately from the gas identity. Record 'N/A' where a single gas is used.

laQicpmsUPb_constantsAndReferenceValuesU.title: Constants and Reference Values Used
laQicpmsUPb_constantsAndReferenceValuesU.description: Physical constants and reference values used in data reduction to calculate the final reported quantity (e.g., decay constants for age calculation, standard isotope ratios, or other citable reference values used in a correction or calculation), together with their source. Distinct from the Group 6 reference-material fields, which document accepted values for specific calibration/validation materials rather than universal physical constants. Record "None" if no citable, revisable physical constants feed into this procedure's data reduction.

laQicpmsUPb_coolantGasFlowRate.title: Coolant (Plasma) Gas Flow Rate
laQicpmsUPb_coolantGasFlowRate.description: Flow rate of the outer (coolant/plasma) argon gas stream that sustains the ICP plasma, in L/min.

laQicpmsUPb_coupledDatasetOrPublicationR.title: Coupled Dataset or Publication Reference
laQicpmsUPb_coupledDatasetOrPublicationR.description: DOI or other persistent identifier for the co-registered dataset or publication where both datasets are reported together. Accepts: a dedicated dataset DOI (if separately deposited), a shared dataset DOI (if co-submitted in the same package), or a publication DOI. Use "same submission" if the coupled dataset is included in this data package, or "pending" if not yet assigned. If coupling is documented through a shared sample identifier only, that information is already captured in Sample Persistent Identifier (Group 2).

laQicpmsUPb_coupledProcedureDoi.title: Coupled Procedure DOI
laQicpmsUPb_coupledProcedureDoi.description: Registered procedure DOI for the coupled technique named above. If the coupled procedure has not yet been registered, enter the DOI of a publication describing the coupled method, or "pending". Enter "None" if no coupling is planned.

laQicpmsUPb_dataProcessingSoftware.title: Data Processing Software(s)
laQicpmsUPb_dataProcessingSoftware.description: All software applied to the data after acquisition in order to produce the reported quantities, including version numbers. List every package used. Distinct from Acquisition Software, which controls the instrument and collects the raw data.

laQicpmsUPb_discordanceDefinitionAndValu.title: Discordance Definition and Values
laQicpmsUPb_discordanceDefinitionAndValu.description: How discordance between the 206Pb/238U, 207Pb/235U and 207Pb/206Pb chronometers is defined for this procedure, and the discordance values obtained. State the formula used. The rule for excluding discordant analyses, and how many were excluded, belong in Analysis Inclusion and Rejection Criteria.

laQicpmsUPb_doublyChargedSpeciesMonitor.title: Doubly-Charged Species Monitor
laQicpmsUPb_doublyChargedSpeciesMonitor.description: The mass ratio monitored to estimate doubly-charged ion (M²⁺) formation during instrument tuning. The monitor species and the mass positions monitored should be stated explicitly. Analogous to Oxide Production Method and Threshold for oxide monitoring.

laQicpmsUPb_doublyChargedSpeciesProducti.title: Doubly-Charged Species Production
laQicpmsUPb_doublyChargedSpeciesProducti.description: Measured percentage of doubly-charged ion production for the monitored species at the time of instrument tuning. The acceptable threshold is typically <1% or <3%. Record both the threshold and the measured value.

laQicpmsUPb_dwellTimePerMass.title: Dwell Time per Mass
laQicpmsUPb_dwellTimePerMass.description: Count (dwell) time at the mass position, in milliseconds. Where the procedure defines it per sweep or per scan rather than per measurement, state that basis.

laQicpmsUPb_fusionFluxAndDilutionRatio.title: Fusion Flux and Dilution Ratio
laQicpmsUPb_fusionFluxAndDilutionRatio.description: For procedures using fused glass, the flux type and sample:flux dilution ratio used to prepare the analytical glass.

laQicpmsUPb_icpTuning.title: ICP Tuning
laQicpmsUPb_icpTuning.description: Description of the approach used to optimise ICP plasma conditions prior to analysis, including the reference material used for tuning and the acceptance criteria (e.g., oxide production threshold, sensitivity targets, mass calibration).

laQicpmsUPb_inheritedOrInitialSignalCorr.title: Inherited or Initial Signal Correction
laQicpmsUPb_inheritedOrInitialSignalCorr.description: How any non-radiogenic, inherited or pre-existing component of the measured signal was accounted for, including the composition assumed, its source, and its uncertainty. Record 'None' where the measured quantity accumulates from zero and no such component exists.

laQicpmsUPb_instrumentSensitivity.title: Instrument Sensitivity
laQicpmsUPb_instrumentSensitivity.description: Instrument sensitivity achieved in the session, with the isotope or channel it was measured on and the conditions it applies to. May be expressed either as detected signal per unit concentration or per unit mass of analyte delivered — counts per second per ppb, volts per ppm, counts per picogram — or as useful yield, the percentage of sampled atoms ultimately detected as ions, with the method used to derive it cited. A sensitivity the procedure requires before analyses may begin belongs with the tuning acceptance criteria.

laQicpmsUPb_instrumentSerialNumberOrLabI.title: Instrument Serial Number or Lab Identifier
laQicpmsUPb_instrumentSerialNumberOrLabI.description: Serial number or laboratory-internal identifier for the specific instrument unit.

schema:name.const: Instrument Serial Number or Lab Identifier

laQicpmsUPb_instrumentWarmUpSessionDurat.title: Instrument Warm-up / Session Duration Limit
laQicpmsUPb_instrumentWarmUpSessionDurat.description: Minimum warm-up time required after plasma ignition before analyses begin, and any maximum session duration enforced to maintain stable operating conditions.

laQicpmsUPb_intermediateDaughterDisequil.title: Intermediate Daughter Disequilibrium Correction
laQicpmsUPb_intermediateDaughterDisequil.description: Correction for initial disequilibrium in intermediate daughter products of the U decay chains — principally 230Th, and where relevant 231Pa — together with the Th/U or Pa/U partitioning value assumed and its source. Record 'None' with a justification where no correction was applied.

laQicpmsUPb_ionCounterDeadTime.title: Ion Counter Dead Time
laQicpmsUPb_ionCounterDeadTime.description: Dead time of each ion-counting detector channel, used in the dead-time correction applied to high count rates. Distinct from pulse/analog cross-calibration, which relates the two detector modes rather than correcting counting losses within the pulse-counting mode.

laQicpmsUPb_laserBeamEnergyProfile.title: Laser Beam Energy Profile
laQicpmsUPb_laserBeamEnergyProfile.description: Spatial energy distribution of the laser beam at the sample surface, and whether a beam homogenizer is installed.

laQicpmsUPb_laserEnergy.title: Laser Energy
laQicpmsUPb_laserEnergy.description: Laser pulse energy in millijoules as set at the laser output or measured at the sample surface. Report only when the system displays energy directly. Laser fluence (J cm⁻²) is the preferred quantity and is captured in Laser Fluence (Energy Density).

laQicpmsUPb_laserFluence.title: Laser Fluence (Energy Density)
laQicpmsUPb_laserFluence.description: Laser pulse energy per unit area at the sample surface in J cm⁻², as registered by the procedure. If the system reports only as % of maximum output, include that value and note the system maximum where known.

laQicpmsUPb_laserRepetitionRate.title: Laser Repetition Rate
laQicpmsUPb_laserRepetitionRate.description: Laser pulse repetition rate in hertz registered by the procedure.

laQicpmsUPb_laserSpotGeometry.title: Laser Spot Geometry
laQicpmsUPb_laserSpotGeometry.description: Shape and dimensions of the laser ablation spot in micrometres registered by the procedure. For circular spots, report diameter; for square or rectangular spots, report width × length.

laQicpmsUPb_makeUpGasAndFlowRate.title: Make-up Gas and Flow Rate
laQicpmsUPb_makeUpGasAndFlowRate.description: Supplementary gas added to the sample-carrying stream between the sample introduction system and the plasma, with its identity and the procedure-registered target flow rate. Record any small nitrogen or hydrogen addition with its own flow, whose unit commonly differs from the make-up flow. Record 'None' explicitly where no supplementary gas is added, to distinguish it from not reported.

laQicpmsUPb_massResolutionSetting.title: Mass Resolution Setting
laQicpmsUPb_massResolutionSetting.description: Operating mass resolution of the mass analyser. Where the analyser permits selection, state the mode; where individual analytes are assigned to different modes, state each.

laQicpmsUPb_matrixOffsetCorrection.title: Matrix Offset Correction (LIEF)
laQicpmsUPb_matrixOffsetCorrection.description: Whether an empirical correction was applied to account for systematic differences in laser-induced elemental fractionation (LIEF) patterns between the external calibration standard and the sample matrix.

laQicpmsUPb_memoryEffectMitigation.title: Memory Effect Mitigation
laQicpmsUPb_memoryEffectMitigation.description: Procedure applied to identify and minimise carry-over of high-concentration or isotopically distinct material from a preceding measurement into the current one. Mitigation is applied primarily at measurement time, by allowing sufficient washout or rinse between successive introductions. At data processing level, record any flagging or exclusion of measurements where the required washout may not have been achieved.

laQicpmsUPb_multiRunSequentialAnalysisDe.title: Multi-Run Sequential Analysis Design
laQicpmsUPb_multiRunSequentialAnalysisDe.description: Whether the procedure uses a single acquisition pass or multiple sequential runs on the same sample location, each optimized for different analytical objectives. For multi-run designs, describe the number of runs, their purpose, key laser and instrument settings per run, and how outputs of one run feed into data reduction of another. Not applicable to raster mapping, where each spatial location is visited exactly once.

laQicpmsUPb_normalizationStandardsBasedC.title: Normalization / Standards-Based Correction
laQicpmsUPb_normalizationStandardsBasedC.description: Post-acquisition normalization applied to the reported data beyond the primary calibration — for example correction to a reference value derived from secondary reference materials, or correction for a systematic bias those materials reveal. Record 'None' if no additional normalization is applied.

laQicpmsUPb_preAblationSurfaceTreatment.title: Pre-Ablation Surface Treatment
laQicpmsUPb_preAblationSurfaceTreatment.description: Procedure applied immediately before each analysis to remove surface contamination or condition the sample surface. Distinct from general sample preparation. For spot analysis, pre-ablation pulses are discarded before signal acquisition begins. For mapping, this step is typically omitted.

laQicpmsUPb_preAnalysisImagingAndScreeni.title: Pre-Analysis Imaging and Screening
laQicpmsUPb_preAnalysisImagingAndScreeni.description: Imaging or other characterisation performed before the measurement in order to select or locate the sampling unit to be analysed, including the technique, instrument and settings used, and how individual analyses are linked back to the images. Distinct from any imaging the procedure performs as its own measurement. Where the imaging is performed on a separate instrument, it should also be recorded in the Group 1 coupling fields.

laQicpmsUPb_primaryCalibrationStandardNa.title: Primary Calibration Standard Name
laQicpmsUPb_primaryCalibrationStandardNa.description: Name and reference material identifier of the primary reference material(s) against which the instrument is calibrated — converting raw signal intensities to concentrations, or anchoring an isotope ratio as the bracketing standard or zero-delta reference. Give the material name, its source or supplier, and a citation for the accepted values used. Where calibration instead uses the vendor's stored library or theoretical response factors rather than measured reference materials — 'standardless' or 'semi-quantitative' quantification — record that here, naming the library or model used. 'None' means no calibration was performed at all, which is a different answer.

laQicpmsUPb_pulseAnalogDetectorNonlinear.title: Pulse/Analog Detector Nonlinearity Correction
laQicpmsUPb_pulseAnalogDetectorNonlinear.description: Whether a correction was applied for nonlinear detector response at the transition between pulse-counting and analog (and Faraday, for triple-mode instruments) detection modes. Cross-calibration factors between detector modes must be confirmed, typically measured each session. Record 'Applied' and describe the method, the detector modes involved and the analytes affected; 'None' where a crossover exists on this instrument but no correction was made, giving the reason; and 'N/A' where the detector is pulse-counting only and no crossover exists.

laQicpmsUPb_rasterLineSpacing.title: Raster Line Spacing (Mapping Only)
laQicpmsUPb_rasterLineSpacing.description: Distance between adjacent raster lines in a 2D elemental map, measured perpendicular to the scan direction, in micrometres. Applies to raster mapping only.

laQicpmsUPb_reactionGasFlowRate.title: Reaction Gas Flow Rate
laQicpmsUPb_reactionGasFlowRate.description: Flow rate of the reactive gas introduced into the dynamic reaction cell (DRC), in mL/min. Record 'None' if DRC mode is not used, and 'N/A' where Collision/Reaction Cell (CRC) Configuration does not include DRC or the instrument has no cell.

laQicpmsUPb_reactionGasType.title: Reaction Gas Type
laQicpmsUPb_reactionGasType.description: Type of reactive gas introduced into the cell for interference removal through ION-MOLECULE CHEMISTRY, either on-mass or by mass shift. Common reaction gases include NH₃ (e.g., for Fe, Ca, K isotopes), O₂ (e.g., for As, Ge, Te mass shift) and CH₄. The distinction from Collision Gas Type is the mechanism, not the gas: record a gas here when a reaction is intended. Record 'None' if no reactive gas is used, and 'N/A' where Collision/Reaction Cell (CRC) Configuration does not include a reaction mode or the instrument has no cell.

laQicpmsUPb_reactionProductIonMassShiftT.title: Reaction Product Ion / Mass-Shift Transition
laQicpmsUPb_reactionProductIonMassShiftT.description: Where a monitored mass is produced by a reaction in the collision/reaction cell, the precursor ion, the reagent gas and the product ion measured. Records the mass-shift chemistry relating the mass measured to the analyte it reports, which the monitored mass alone does not state. Record 'N/A' where the analyte is measured on its own mass.

laQicpmsUPb_reportedDateType.title: Reported Date Type
laQicpmsUPb_reportedDateType.description: The kind of date or age the procedure reports. Where more than one type is reported, list all, separated by semicolons.

laQicpmsUPb_rfPower.title: RF Power
laQicpmsUPb_rfPower.description: Radiofrequency forward power applied to the ICP, in watts.

laQicpmsUPb_sampleFormAnalyticalSubstrat.title: Sample Form / Analytical Substrate
laQicpmsUPb_sampleFormAnalyticalSubstrat.description: Physical form of the material as it enters the ablation cell. Variations that do not alter the analytical procedure (e.g., thin section vs. mount) are legitimate.

laQicpmsUPb_samplePersistentIdentifier.title: Sample Persistent Identifier
laQicpmsUPb_samplePersistentIdentifier.description: Globally unique, persistent identifier for each sample listed in Sample Name. IGSN (International Geo Sample Number) is the recommended standard for geological and cosmochemical samples, as used by Astromat, EarthChem and SESAR. Where a sample and its sub-samples are separately registered, record the identifier at the level actually analysed.

laQicpmsUPb_samplePreparationMethod.title: Sample Preparation Method
laQicpmsUPb_samplePreparationMethod.description: The form in which the sample is presented to the instrument, and the preparation that brought it to that form — for example mounting, sectioning, polishing, coating, crushing, fusion, or extraction of an electron-transparent section. Record 'None' where the material is analysed as received.

laQicpmsUPb_samplerAndSkimmerConeMateria.title: Sampler and Skimmer Cone Material
laQicpmsUPb_samplerAndSkimmerConeMateria.description: Material composition of the sampler and skimmer cones. State both sampler and skimmer materials; a single statement is acceptable where they are identical.

laQicpmsUPb_samplingUnitSelectionCriteri.title: Sampling Unit Selection Criteria
laQicpmsUPb_samplingUnitSelectionCriteri.description: The rules governing which sampling unit(s) within a sample are selected for analysis, and why. Covers the criteria applied when choosing grains, aliquots, spots, or a region of interest — size, morphology, clarity, freedom from inclusions or alteration, phase identity, or spatial position. Distinct from Target Material, which states the material type the procedure is designed for, and from Sampling Unit, which names the kind of subdivision one row of reported values corresponds to: this field states how, within such a sample, the unit actually analysed is picked out.

laQicpmsUPb_secondaryReferenceMaterials.title: Secondary Reference Materials
laQicpmsUPb_secondaryReferenceMaterials.description: Quality-control reference material(s) measured as unknowns alongside samples to assess accuracy independently and to monitor drift. Give the material name, its source, and a citation for the accepted or reference values used for comparison.

laQicpmsUPb_signalSmoothing.title: Signal Smoothing
laQicpmsUPb_signalSmoothing.description: Description of any signal smoothing device or approach installed between the ablation cell and the ICP-MS to reduce pulse-to-pulse signal variability. For mapping analyses, report "None" explicitly.

laQicpmsUPb_spikeOutlierFilteringApproac.title: Spike / Outlier Filtering Approach
laQicpmsUPb_spikeOutlierFilteringApproac.description: Criteria used to identify and exclude anomalous data - signal spikes, individual cycles, or whole replicate measurements - before the reported value is calculated. State where in the reduction sequence the filter is applied.

laQicpmsUPb_torchDepth.title: Torch Depth
laQicpmsUPb_torchDepth.description: Distance between the load coil and the sampling cone tip (mm), also called injector depth or torch position depending on the instrument manufacturer.

laQicpmsUPb_torchType.title: Torch Type
laQicpmsUPb_torchType.description: Type of plasma torch installed (e.g. standard quartz, high-matrix, low-flow).

laQicpmsUPb_totalIntegrationTimePerOutpu.title: Total Integration Time per Output Data Point
laQicpmsUPb_totalIntegrationTimePerOutpu.description: Total duty-cycle time for one complete mass-scan sweep — the sum of all per-isotope dwell times plus inter-mass settling times. Not recoverable from Dwell Time per Mass alone, because settling time is not captured there. Applies to sequential (quadrupole and single-collector sector-field) acquisition.

schema:name.const: Total Integration Time per Output Data Point

laQicpmsUPb_transectRateMappingRateOrSte.title: Transect Rate, Mapping Rate or Step Size
laQicpmsUPb_transectRateMappingRateOrSte.description: For continuous line scan (transect) and raster mapping: the stage translation speed in µm s⁻¹. For mapping, the mapping rate (mm² h⁻¹) may be reported as an alternative when scan speed is session-variable. For stepped line profiles: the distance between successive spot positions in µm.

schema:name.const: Transect Rate, Mapping Rate or Step Size

laQicpmsUPb_uncertaintyPropagationMethod.title: Uncertainty Propagation Method
laQicpmsUPb_uncertaintyPropagationMethod.description: The approach used to propagate analytical uncertainty through the data reduction chain to the final reported value. State which sources are included in the propagation: counting statistics, calibration standard uncertainty, internal standard uncertainty, drift correction, and any systematic contributions. Distinct from Uncertainty Level, which states the convention at which the resulting uncertainty is quoted.

laQicpms_ablationDurationPerSpot.title: Ablation Duration per Spot
laQicpms_ablationDurationPerSpot.description: Total on-sample ablation (signal acquisition) time per individual spot in seconds, as set in the acquisition method. For transect analysis, the equivalent procedure-level parameter is scan speed (captured in Transect Rate, Mapping Rate or Step Size). For mapping analysis, total acquisition time is sample-area-dependent and is not captured here.

laQicpms_ablationPitDepthAndAblationRate.title: Ablation Pit Depth and Ablation Rate
laQicpms_ablationPitDepthAndAblationRate.description: Depth of the ablation pit produced under the registered laser conditions, the method used to measure it, and the resulting per-pulse ablation rate. For transect and mapping the equivalent quantity is trench depth under the same conditions.

schema:name.const: Ablation Pit Depth and Ablation Rate

laQicpms_analysisSequence.title: Analysis Sequence
laQicpms_analysisSequence.description: The repeating order in which calibration or bracketing standards, quality-control and secondary reference materials, blanks and unknowns are interleaved within a measurement session. Adjustments must maintain the bracketing strategy defined in the procedure.

laQicpms_auxiliaryGasFlowRate.title: Auxiliary Gas Flow Rate
laQicpms_auxiliaryGasFlowRate.description: Flow rate of the intermediate (auxiliary) argon gas stream, between the torch body and the injector tube, which positions the plasma relative to the load coil, in L/min. Distinct from the outer coolant (plasma) gas and from the gas stream that carries sample into the plasma.

laQicpms_backgroundCountTime.title: Background Count Time
laQicpms_backgroundCountTime.description: Total time spent measuring gas blank (background signal with laser off or shutter closed) before each ablation event, in seconds. For spot and transect analysis, a discrete background interval is measured before each ablation. For mapping, background is typically measured once per raster line or at the start of a map session rather than before each individual pixel.

laQicpms_calibrationFactorAndDeterminati.title: Calibration Factor and Determination Method
laQicpms_calibrationFactorAndDeterminati.description: An externally-calibrated factor that converts the measured quantity into the reported quantity, how it was determined, and its uncertainty. Applies where the conversion depends on a factor calibrated against a reference of independently known value, rather than on the instrument response alone. Distinct from the fields that name the calibration material and that state which approach applies to which analyte, where the technique has them: this field records the resulting factor itself.

laQicpms_carrierGasAndFlowRate.title: Carrier Gas and Flow Rate
laQicpms_carrierGasAndFlowRate.description: Gas used to transport ablated aerosol from the ablation cell to the ICP-MS torch, with the procedure-registered target flow rate(s). Adjustment during tuning stays within ±10% of the target.

laQicpms_cellExitDiscriminationVoltage.title: Cell Exit Discrimination Voltage
laQicpms_cellExitDiscriminationVoltage.description: Bias voltage applied at the collision/reaction cell exit to discriminate between analyte ions and low-energy polyatomic interferences in KED mode, in volts (V). Record 'None' if the cell is in STD mode, and 'N/A' where Collision/Reaction Cell (CRC) Configuration does not include KED or the instrument has no cell.

laQicpms_collisionGasFlowRate.title: Collision Gas Flow Rate
laQicpms_collisionGasFlowRate.description: Flow rate of the collision gas, typically He, introduced into the collision/reaction cell in KED mode, in mL/min. Record 'None' if the cell is in STD mode, and 'N/A' where Collision/Reaction Cell (CRC) Configuration does not include KED or the instrument has no cell.

laQicpms_collisionReactionGasMixtureRati.title: Collision/Reaction Gas Mixture Ratio
laQicpms_collisionReactionGasMixtureRati.description: Where the collision or reaction cell is supplied with a mixture of gases rather than a single gas, the identities and proportions of that mixture. Recorded separately from the gas identity. Record 'N/A' where a single gas is used.

laQicpms_massResolutionSetting.description: Operating mass resolution of the mass analyser. Where the analyser permits selection, state the mode; where individual analytes are assigned to different modes, state each.

laQicpms_matrixOffsetCorrection.title: Matrix Offset Correction (LIEF)
laQicpms_matrixOffsetCorrection.description: Whether an empirical correction was applied to account for systematic differences in laser-induced elemental fractionation (LIEF) patterns between the external calibration standard and the sample matrix.

laQicpms_memoryEffectMitigation.title: Memory Effect Mitigation
laQicpms_memoryEffectMitigation.description: Procedure applied to identify and minimise carry-over of high-concentration or isotopically distinct material from a preceding measurement into the current one. Mitigation is applied primarily at measurement time, by allowing sufficient washout or rinse between successive introductions. At data processing level, record any flagging or exclusion of measurements where the required washout may not have been achieved.

laQicpms_multiRunSequentialAnalysisDesig.title: Multi-Run Sequential Analysis Design
laQicpms_multiRunSequentialAnalysisDesig.description: Whether the procedure uses a single acquisition pass or multiple sequential runs on the same sample location, each optimized for different analytical objectives. For multi-run designs, describe the number of runs, their purpose, key laser and instrument settings per run, and how outputs of one run feed into data reduction of another. Not applicable to raster mapping, where each spatial location is visited exactly once.

laQicpms_normalizationStandardsBasedCorr.title: Normalization / Standards-Based Correction
laQicpms_normalizationStandardsBasedCorr.description: Post-acquisition normalization applied to the reported data beyond the primary calibration — for example correction to a reference value derived from secondary reference materials, or correction for a systematic bias those materials reveal. Record 'None' if no additional normalization is applied.

laQicpms_preAblationSurfaceTreatment.title: Pre-Ablation Surface Treatment
laQicpms_preAblationSurfaceTreatment.description: Procedure applied immediately before each analysis to remove surface contamination or condition the sample surface. Distinct from general sample preparation. For spot analysis, pre-ablation pulses are discarded before signal acquisition begins. For mapping, this step is typically omitted.

laQicpms_preAnalysisImagingAndScreening.title: Pre-Analysis Imaging and Screening
laQicpms_preAnalysisImagingAndScreening.description: Imaging or other characterisation performed before the measurement in order to select or locate the sampling unit to be analysed, including the technique, instrument and settings used, and how individual analyses are linked back to the images. Distinct from any imaging the procedure performs as its own measurement. Where the imaging is performed on a separate instrument, it should also be recorded in the Group 1 coupling fields.

laQicpms_primaryCalibrationStandardName.title: Primary Calibration Standard Name
laQicpms_primaryCalibrationStandardName.description: Name and reference material identifier of the primary reference material(s) against which the instrument is calibrated — converting raw signal intensities to concentrations, or anchoring an isotope ratio as the bracketing standard or zero-delta reference. Give the material name, its source or supplier, and a citation for the accepted values used. Where calibration instead uses the vendor's stored library or theoretical response factors rather than measured reference materials — 'standardless' or 'semi-quantitative' quantification — record that here, naming the library or model used. 'None' means no calibration was performed at all, which is a different answer.

laQicpms_pulseAnalogDetectorNonlinearity.title: Pulse/Analog Detector Nonlinearity Correction
laQicpms_pulseAnalogDetectorNonlinearity.description: Whether a correction was applied for nonlinear detector response at the transition between pulse-counting and analog (and Faraday, for triple-mode instruments) detection modes. Cross-calibration factors between detector modes must be confirmed, typically measured each session. Record 'Applied' and describe the method, the detector modes involved and the analytes affected; 'None' where a crossover exists on this instrument but no correction was made, giving the reason; and 'N/A' where the detector is pulse-counting only and no crossover exists.

laQicpms_rasterLineSpacing.title: Raster Line Spacing (Mapping Only)
laQicpms_rasterLineSpacing.description: Distance between adjacent raster lines in a 2D elemental map, measured perpendicular to the scan direction, in micrometres. Applies to raster mapping only.

laQicpms_reactionGasFlowRate.title: Reaction Gas Flow Rate
laQicpms_reactionGasFlowRate.description: Flow rate of the reactive gas introduced into the dynamic reaction cell (DRC), in mL/min. Record 'None' if DRC mode is not used, and 'N/A' where Collision/Reaction Cell (CRC) Configuration does not include DRC or the instrument has no cell.

laQicpms_reactionGasType.title: Reaction Gas Type
laQicpms_reactionGasType.description: Type of reactive gas introduced into the cell for interference removal through ION-MOLECULE CHEMISTRY, either on-mass or by mass shift. Common reaction gases include NH₃ (e.g., for Fe, Ca, K isotopes), O₂ (e.g., for As, Ge, Te mass shift) and CH₄. The distinction from Collision Gas Type is the mechanism, not the gas: record a gas here when a reaction is intended. Record 'None' if no reactive gas is used, and 'N/A' where Collision/Reaction Cell (CRC) Configuration does not include a reaction mode or the instrument has no cell.

laQicpms_reactionProductIonMassShiftTran.title: Reaction Product Ion / Mass-Shift Transition
laQicpms_reactionProductIonMassShiftTran.description: Where a monitored mass is produced by a reaction in the collision/reaction cell, the precursor ion, the reagent gas and the product ion measured. Records the mass-shift chemistry relating the mass measured to the analyte it reports, which the monitored mass alone does not state. Record 'N/A' where the analyte is measured on its own mass.

laQicpms_rfPower.title: RF Power
laQicpms_rfPower.description: Radiofrequency forward power applied to the ICP, in watts.

laQicpms_sampleFormAnalyticalSubstrate.title: Sample Form / Analytical Substrate
laQicpms_sampleFormAnalyticalSubstrate.description: Physical form of the material as it enters the ablation cell. Variations that do not alter the analytical procedure (e.g., thin section vs. mount) are legitimate.

laQicpms_samplePersistentIdentifier.title: Sample Persistent Identifier
laQicpms_samplePersistentIdentifier.description: Globally unique, persistent identifier for each sample listed in Sample Name. IGSN (International Geo Sample Number) is the recommended standard for geological and cosmochemical samples, as used by Astromat, EarthChem and SESAR. Where a sample and its sub-samples are separately registered, record the identifier at the level actually analysed.

laQicpms_samplePreparationMethod.title: Sample Preparation Method
laQicpms_samplePreparationMethod.description: The form in which the sample is presented to the instrument, and the preparation that brought it to that form — for example mounting, sectioning, polishing, coating, crushing, fusion, or extraction of an electron-transparent section. Record 'None' where the material is analysed as received.

laQicpms_samplerAndSkimmerConeMaterial.title: Sampler and Skimmer Cone Material
laQicpms_samplerAndSkimmerConeMaterial.description: Material composition of the sampler and skimmer cones. State both sampler and skimmer materials; a single statement is acceptable where they are identical.

laQicpms_samplingUnitSelectionCriteria.title: Sampling Unit Selection Criteria
laQicpms_samplingUnitSelectionCriteria.description: The rules governing which sampling unit(s) within a sample are selected for analysis, and why. Covers the criteria applied when choosing grains, aliquots, spots, or a region of interest — size, morphology, clarity, freedom from inclusions or alteration, phase identity, or spatial position. Distinct from Target Material, which states the material type the procedure is designed for, and from Sampling Unit, which names the kind of subdivision one row of reported values corresponds to: this field states how, within such a sample, the unit actually analysed is picked out.

laQicpms_secondaryReferenceMaterials.title: Secondary Reference Materials
laQicpms_secondaryReferenceMaterials.description: Quality-control reference material(s) measured as unknowns alongside samples to assess accuracy independently and to monitor drift. Give the material name, its source, and a citation for the accepted or reference values used for comparison.

laQicpms_signalSmoothing.title: Signal Smoothing
laQicpms_signalSmoothing.description: Description of any signal smoothing device or approach installed between the ablation cell and the ICP-MS to reduce pulse-to-pulse signal variability. For mapping analyses, report "None" explicitly.

laQicpms_spikeOutlierFilteringApproach.title: Spike / Outlier Filtering Approach
laQicpms_spikeOutlierFilteringApproach.description: Criteria used to identify and exclude anomalous data - signal spikes, individual cycles, or whole replicate measurements - before the reported value is calculated. State where in the reduction sequence the filter is applied.

laQicpms_torchDepth.title: Torch Depth
laQicpms_torchDepth.description: Distance between the load coil and the sampling cone tip (mm), also called injector depth or torch position depending on the instrument manufacturer.

laQicpms_torchType.title: Torch Type
laQicpms_torchType.description: Type of plasma torch installed (e.g. standard quartz, high-matrix, low-flow).

laQicpms_totalIntegrationTimePerOutputDa.title: Total Integration Time per Output Data Point
laQicpms_totalIntegrationTimePerOutputDa.description: Total duty-cycle time for one complete mass-scan sweep — the sum of all per-isotope dwell times plus inter-mass settling times. Not recoverable from Dwell Time per Mass alone, because settling time is not captured there. Applies to sequential (quadrupole and single-collector sector-field) acquisition.

schema:name.const: Total Integration Time per Output Data Point

laQicpms_transectRateMappingRateOrStepSi.title: Transect Rate, Mapping Rate or Step Size
laQicpms_transectRateMappingRateOrStepSi.description: For continuous line scan (transect) and raster mapping: the stage translation speed in µm s⁻¹. For mapping, the mapping rate (mm² h⁻¹) may be reported as an alternative when scan speed is session-variable. For stepped line profiles: the distance between successive spot positions in µm.

schema:name.const: Transect Rate, Mapping Rate or Step Size

laQicpms_uncertaintyPropagationMethod.title: Uncertainty Propagation Method
laQicpms_uncertaintyPropagationMethod.description: The approach used to propagate analytical uncertainty through the data reduction chain to the final reported value. State which sources are included in the propagation: counting statistics, calibration standard uncertainty, internal standard uncertainty, drift correction, and any systematic contributions. Distinct from Uncertainty Level, which states the convention at which the resulting uncertainty is quoted.

laSficpmsUPb_ablationDurationPerSpot.title: Ablation Duration per Spot
laSficpmsUPb_ablationDurationPerSpot.description: Total on-sample ablation (signal acquisition) time per individual spot in seconds, as set in the acquisition method. For transect analysis, the equivalent procedure-level parameter is scan speed (captured in Transect Rate, Mapping Rate or Step Size). For mapping analysis, total acquisition time is sample-area-dependent and is not captured here.

laSficpmsUPb_ablationPitDepthAndAblation.title: Ablation Pit Depth and Ablation Rate
laSficpmsUPb_ablationPitDepthAndAblation.description: Depth of the ablation pit produced under the registered laser conditions, the method used to measure it, and the resulting per-pulse ablation rate. For transect and mapping the equivalent quantity is trench depth under the same conditions.

schema:name.const: Ablation Pit Depth and Ablation Rate

laSficpmsUPb_ageModel.title: Age Model
laSficpmsUPb_ageModel.description: The statistical model used to combine individual analyses into a single reported age, including any criteria governing which model is applied. Record the model only — the software implementing it belongs in Data Reduction Software (Group 3), whose scope already extends to age calculation; where reduction and age regression use different packages, list both there.

laSficpmsUPb_analysisSequence.title: Analysis Sequence
laSficpmsUPb_analysisSequence.description: The repeating order in which calibration or bracketing standards, quality-control and secondary reference materials, blanks and unknowns are interleaved within a measurement session. Adjustments must maintain the bracketing strategy defined in the procedure.

laSficpmsUPb_auxiliaryGasFlowRate.title: Auxiliary Gas Flow Rate
laSficpmsUPb_auxiliaryGasFlowRate.description: Flow rate of the intermediate (auxiliary) argon gas stream, between the torch body and the injector tube, which positions the plasma relative to the load coil, in L/min. Distinct from the outer coolant (plasma) gas and from the gas stream that carries sample into the plasma.

laSficpmsUPb_backgroundCountTime.title: Background Count Time
laSficpmsUPb_backgroundCountTime.description: Total time spent measuring gas blank (background signal with laser off or shutter closed) before each ablation event, in seconds. For spot and transect analysis, a discrete background interval is measured before each ablation. For mapping, background is typically measured once per raster line or at the start of a map session rather than before each individual pixel.

laSficpmsUPb_calibrationFactorAndDetermi.title: Calibration Factor and Determination Method
laSficpmsUPb_calibrationFactorAndDetermi.description: An externally-calibrated factor that converts the measured quantity into the reported quantity, how it was determined, and its uncertainty. Applies where the conversion depends on a factor calibrated against a reference of independently known value, rather than on the instrument response alone. Distinct from the fields that name the calibration material and that state which approach applies to which analyte, where the technique has them: this field records the resulting factor itself.

laSficpmsUPb_carrierGasAndFlowRate.title: Carrier Gas and Flow Rate
laSficpmsUPb_carrierGasAndFlowRate.description: Gas used to transport ablated aerosol from the ablation cell to the ICP-MS torch, with the procedure-registered target flow rate(s). Adjustment during tuning stays within ±10% of the target.

laSficpmsUPb_constantsAndReferenceValues.title: Constants and Reference Values Used
laSficpmsUPb_constantsAndReferenceValues.description: Physical constants and reference values used in data reduction to calculate the final reported quantity (e.g., decay constants for age calculation, standard isotope ratios, or other citable reference values used in a correction or calculation), together with their source. Distinct from the Group 6 reference-material fields, which document accepted values for specific calibration/validation materials rather than universal physical constants. Record "None" if no citable, revisable physical constants feed into this procedure's data reduction.

laSficpmsUPb_coolantGasFlowRate.title: Coolant (Plasma) Gas Flow Rate
laSficpmsUPb_coolantGasFlowRate.description: Flow rate of the outer (coolant/plasma) argon gas stream that sustains the ICP plasma, in L/min.

laSficpmsUPb_coupledDatasetOrPublication.title: Coupled Dataset or Publication Reference
laSficpmsUPb_coupledDatasetOrPublication.description: DOI or other persistent identifier for the co-registered dataset or publication where both datasets are reported together. Accepts: a dedicated dataset DOI (if separately deposited), a shared dataset DOI (if co-submitted in the same package), or a publication DOI. Use "same submission" if the coupled dataset is included in this data package, or "pending" if not yet assigned. If coupling is documented through a shared sample identifier only, that information is already captured in Sample Persistent Identifier (Group 2).

laSficpmsUPb_coupledProcedureDoi.title: Coupled Procedure DOI
laSficpmsUPb_coupledProcedureDoi.description: Registered procedure DOI for the coupled technique named above. If the coupled procedure has not yet been registered, enter the DOI of a publication describing the coupled method, or "pending". Enter "None" if no coupling is planned.

laSficpmsUPb_dataProcessingSoftware.title: Data Processing Software(s)
laSficpmsUPb_dataProcessingSoftware.description: All software applied to the data after acquisition in order to produce the reported quantities, including version numbers. List every package used. Distinct from Acquisition Software, which controls the instrument and collects the raw data.

laSficpmsUPb_discordanceDefinitionAndVal.title: Discordance Definition and Values
laSficpmsUPb_discordanceDefinitionAndVal.description: How discordance between the 206Pb/238U, 207Pb/235U and 207Pb/206Pb chronometers is defined for this procedure, and the discordance values obtained. State the formula used. The rule for excluding discordant analyses, and how many were excluded, belong in Analysis Inclusion and Rejection Criteria.

laSficpmsUPb_doublyChargedSpeciesMonitor.title: Doubly-Charged Species Monitor
laSficpmsUPb_doublyChargedSpeciesMonitor.description: The mass ratio monitored to estimate doubly-charged ion (M²⁺) formation during instrument tuning. The monitor species and the mass positions monitored should be stated explicitly. Analogous to Oxide Production Method and Threshold for oxide monitoring.

laSficpmsUPb_doublyChargedSpeciesProduct.title: Doubly-Charged Species Production
laSficpmsUPb_doublyChargedSpeciesProduct.description: Measured percentage of doubly-charged ion production for the monitored species at the time of instrument tuning. The acceptable threshold is typically <1% or <3%. Record both the threshold and the measured value.

laSficpmsUPb_dwellTimePerMass.title: Dwell Time per Mass
laSficpmsUPb_dwellTimePerMass.description: Count (dwell) time at the mass position, in milliseconds. Where the procedure defines it per sweep or per scan rather than per measurement, state that basis.

laSficpmsUPb_eScanRange.title: E-scan Range
laSficpmsUPb_eScanRange.description: Electric scan range used for peak acquisition, expressed as percentage of the centre mass (%). Record 'N/A' if E-scan acquisition mode is not used.

laSficpmsUPb_fusionFluxAndDilutionRatio.title: Fusion Flux and Dilution Ratio
laSficpmsUPb_fusionFluxAndDilutionRatio.description: For procedures using fused glass, the flux type and sample:flux dilution ratio used to prepare the analytical glass.

laSficpmsUPb_icpTuning.title: ICP Tuning
laSficpmsUPb_icpTuning.description: Description of the approach used to optimise ICP plasma conditions prior to analysis, including the reference material used for tuning and the acceptance criteria (e.g., oxide production threshold, sensitivity targets, mass calibration).

laSficpmsUPb_inheritedOrInitialSignalCor.title: Inherited or Initial Signal Correction
laSficpmsUPb_inheritedOrInitialSignalCor.description: How any non-radiogenic, inherited or pre-existing component of the measured signal was accounted for, including the composition assumed, its source, and its uncertainty. Record 'None' where the measured quantity accumulates from zero and no such component exists.

laSficpmsUPb_instrumentSensitivity.title: Instrument Sensitivity
laSficpmsUPb_instrumentSensitivity.description: Instrument sensitivity achieved in the session, with the isotope or channel it was measured on and the conditions it applies to. May be expressed either as detected signal per unit concentration or per unit mass of analyte delivered — counts per second per ppb, volts per ppm, counts per picogram — or as useful yield, the percentage of sampled atoms ultimately detected as ions, with the method used to derive it cited. A sensitivity the procedure requires before analyses may begin belongs with the tuning acceptance criteria.

laSficpmsUPb_instrumentSerialNumberOrLab.title: Instrument Serial Number or Lab Identifier
laSficpmsUPb_instrumentSerialNumberOrLab.description: Serial number or laboratory-internal identifier for the specific instrument unit.

schema:name.const: Instrument Serial Number or Lab Identifier

laSficpmsUPb_instrumentWarmUpSessionDura.title: Instrument Warm-up / Session Duration Limit
laSficpmsUPb_instrumentWarmUpSessionDura.description: Minimum warm-up time required after plasma ignition before analyses begin, and any maximum session duration enforced to maintain stable operating conditions.

laSficpmsUPb_intermediateDaughterDisequi.title: Intermediate Daughter Disequilibrium Correction
laSficpmsUPb_intermediateDaughterDisequi.description: Correction for initial disequilibrium in intermediate daughter products of the U decay chains — principally 230Th, and where relevant 231Pa — together with the Th/U or Pa/U partitioning value assumed and its source. Record 'None' with a justification where no correction was applied.

laSficpmsUPb_ionCounterDeadTime.title: Ion Counter Dead Time
laSficpmsUPb_ionCounterDeadTime.description: Dead time of each ion-counting detector channel, used in the dead-time correction applied to high count rates. Distinct from pulse/analog cross-calibration, which relates the two detector modes rather than correcting counting losses within the pulse-counting mode.

laSficpmsUPb_laserBeamEnergyProfile.title: Laser Beam Energy Profile
laSficpmsUPb_laserBeamEnergyProfile.description: Spatial energy distribution of the laser beam at the sample surface, and whether a beam homogenizer is installed.

laSficpmsUPb_laserEnergy.title: Laser Energy
laSficpmsUPb_laserEnergy.description: Laser pulse energy in millijoules as set at the laser output or measured at the sample surface. Report only when the system displays energy directly. Laser fluence (J cm⁻²) is the preferred quantity and is captured in Laser Fluence (Energy Density).

laSficpmsUPb_laserFluence.title: Laser Fluence (Energy Density)
laSficpmsUPb_laserFluence.description: Laser pulse energy per unit area at the sample surface in J cm⁻², as registered by the procedure. If the system reports only as % of maximum output, include that value and note the system maximum where known.

laSficpmsUPb_laserRepetitionRate.title: Laser Repetition Rate
laSficpmsUPb_laserRepetitionRate.description: Laser pulse repetition rate in hertz registered by the procedure.

laSficpmsUPb_laserSpotGeometry.title: Laser Spot Geometry
laSficpmsUPb_laserSpotGeometry.description: Shape and dimensions of the laser ablation spot in micrometres registered by the procedure. For circular spots, report diameter; for square or rectangular spots, report width × length.

laSficpmsUPb_makeUpGasAndFlowRate.title: Make-up Gas and Flow Rate
laSficpmsUPb_makeUpGasAndFlowRate.description: Supplementary gas added to the sample-carrying stream between the sample introduction system and the plasma, with its identity and the procedure-registered target flow rate. Record any small nitrogen or hydrogen addition with its own flow, whose unit commonly differs from the make-up flow. Record 'None' explicitly where no supplementary gas is added, to distinguish it from not reported.

laSficpmsUPb_massResolutionSetting.title: Mass Resolution Setting
laSficpmsUPb_massResolutionSetting.description: Operating mass resolution of the mass analyser. Where the analyser permits selection, state the mode; where individual analytes are assigned to different modes, state each.

laSficpmsUPb_reportedDateType.description: The kind of date or age the procedure reports. Where more than one type is reported, list all, separated by semicolons.

laSficpmsUPb_rfPower.description: Radiofrequency forward power applied to the ICP, in watts.
