schema:name.const: Total Integration Time per Output Data Point

laSficpmsUPb_transectRateMappingRateOrSt.title: Transect Rate, Mapping Rate or Step Size
laSficpmsUPb_transectRateMappingRateOrSt.description: For continuous line scan (transect) and raster mapping: the stage translation speed in µm s⁻¹. For mapping, the mapping rate (mm² h⁻¹) may be reported as an alternative when scan speed is session-variable. For stepped line profiles: the distance between successive spot positions in µm.

schema:name.const: Transect Rate, Mapping Rate or Step Size

laSficpmsUPb_tripleScanningMode.title: Triple Scanning Mode
laSficpmsUPb_tripleScanningMode.description: Whether each mass peak is scanned three times per cycle and the results averaged (Y/N). Record 'N/A' if not applicable to the instrument.

laSficpmsUPb_uncertaintyPropagationMetho.title: Uncertainty Propagation Method
laSficpmsUPb_uncertaintyPropagationMetho.description: The approach used to propagate analytical uncertainty through the data reduction chain to the final reported value. State which sources are included in the propagation: counting statistics, calibration standard uncertainty, internal standard uncertainty, drift correction, and any systematic contributions. Distinct from Uncertainty Level, which states the convention at which the resulting uncertainty is quoted.

laSficpms_ablationDurationPerSpot.title: Ablation Duration per Spot
laSficpms_ablationDurationPerSpot.description: Total on-sample ablation (signal acquisition) time per individual spot in seconds, as set in the acquisition method. For transect analysis, the equivalent procedure-level parameter is scan speed (captured in Transect Rate, Mapping Rate or Step Size). For mapping analysis, total acquisition time is sample-area-dependent and is not captured here.

laSficpms_ablationPitDepthAndAblationRat.title: Ablation Pit Depth and Ablation Rate
laSficpms_ablationPitDepthAndAblationRat.description: Depth of the ablation pit produced under the registered laser conditions, the method used to measure it, and the resulting per-pulse ablation rate. For transect and mapping the equivalent quantity is trench depth under the same conditions.

schema:name.const: Ablation Pit Depth and Ablation Rate

laSficpms_analysisSequence.title: Analysis Sequence
laSficpms_analysisSequence.description: The repeating order in which calibration or bracketing standards, quality-control and secondary reference materials, blanks and unknowns are interleaved within a measurement session. Adjustments must maintain the bracketing strategy defined in the procedure.

laSficpms_auxiliaryGasFlowRate.title: Auxiliary Gas Flow Rate
laSficpms_auxiliaryGasFlowRate.description: Flow rate of the intermediate (auxiliary) argon gas stream, between the torch body and the injector tube, which positions the plasma relative to the load coil, in L/min. Distinct from the outer coolant (plasma) gas and from the gas stream that carries sample into the plasma.

laSficpms_backgroundCountTime.title: Background Count Time
laSficpms_backgroundCountTime.description: Total time spent measuring gas blank (background signal with laser off or shutter closed) before each ablation event, in seconds. For spot and transect analysis, a discrete background interval is measured before each ablation. For mapping, background is typically measured once per raster line or at the start of a map session rather than before each individual pixel.

laSficpms_calibrationFactorAndDeterminat.title: Calibration Factor and Determination Method
laSficpms_calibrationFactorAndDeterminat.description: An externally-calibrated factor that converts the measured quantity into the reported quantity, how it was determined, and its uncertainty. Applies where the conversion depends on a factor calibrated against a reference of independently known value, rather than on the instrument response alone. Distinct from the fields that name the calibration material and that state which approach applies to which analyte, where the technique has them: this field records the resulting factor itself.

laSficpms_carrierGasAndFlowRate.title: Carrier Gas and Flow Rate
laSficpms_carrierGasAndFlowRate.description: Gas used to transport ablated aerosol from the ablation cell to the ICP-MS torch, with the procedure-registered target flow rate(s). Adjustment during tuning stays within ±10% of the target.

laSficpms_constantsAndReferenceValuesUse.title: Constants and Reference Values Used
laSficpms_constantsAndReferenceValuesUse.description: Physical constants and reference values used in data reduction to calculate the final reported quantity (e.g., decay constants for age calculation, standard isotope ratios, or other citable reference values used in a correction or calculation), together with their source. Distinct from the Group 6 reference-material fields, which document accepted values for specific calibration/validation materials rather than universal physical constants. Record "None" if no citable, revisable physical constants feed into this procedure's data reduction.

laSficpms_coolantGasFlowRate.title: Coolant (Plasma) Gas Flow Rate
laSficpms_coolantGasFlowRate.description: Flow rate of the outer (coolant/plasma) argon gas stream that sustains the ICP plasma, in L/min.

laSficpms_coupledDatasetOrPublicationRef.title: Coupled Dataset or Publication Reference
laSficpms_coupledDatasetOrPublicationRef.description: DOI or other persistent identifier for the co-registered dataset or publication where both datasets are reported together. Accepts: a dedicated dataset DOI (if separately deposited), a shared dataset DOI (if co-submitted in the same package), or a publication DOI. Use "same submission" if the coupled dataset is included in this data package, or "pending" if not yet assigned. If coupling is documented through a shared sample identifier only, that information is already captured in Sample Persistent Identifier (Group 2).

laSficpms_coupledProcedureDoi.title: Coupled Procedure DOI
laSficpms_coupledProcedureDoi.description: Registered procedure DOI for the coupled technique named above. If the coupled procedure has not yet been registered, enter the DOI of a publication describing the coupled method, or "pending". Enter "None" if no coupling is planned.

laSficpms_dataProcessingSoftware.title: Data Processing Software(s)
laSficpms_dataProcessingSoftware.description: All software applied to the data after acquisition in order to produce the reported quantities, including version numbers. List every package used. Distinct from Acquisition Software, which controls the instrument and collects the raw data.

laSficpms_doublyChargedSpeciesMonitor.title: Doubly-Charged Species Monitor
laSficpms_doublyChargedSpeciesMonitor.description: The mass ratio monitored to estimate doubly-charged ion (M²⁺) formation during instrument tuning. The monitor species and the mass positions monitored should be stated explicitly. Analogous to Oxide Production Method and Threshold for oxide monitoring.

laSficpms_doublyChargedSpeciesProduction.title: Doubly-Charged Species Production
laSficpms_doublyChargedSpeciesProduction.description: Measured percentage of doubly-charged ion production for the monitored species at the time of instrument tuning. The acceptable threshold is typically <1% or <3%. Record both the threshold and the measured value.

laSficpms_dwellTimePerMass.title: Dwell Time per Mass
laSficpms_dwellTimePerMass.description: Count (dwell) time at the mass position, in milliseconds. Where the procedure defines it per sweep or per scan rather than per measurement, state that basis.

laSficpms_eScanRange.title: E-scan Range
laSficpms_eScanRange.description: Electric scan range used for peak acquisition, expressed as percentage of the centre mass (%). Record 'N/A' if E-scan acquisition mode is not used.

laSficpms_fusionFluxAndDilutionRatio.title: Fusion Flux and Dilution Ratio
laSficpms_fusionFluxAndDilutionRatio.description: For procedures using fused glass, the flux type and sample:flux dilution ratio used to prepare the analytical glass.

laSficpms_icpTuning.title: ICP Tuning
laSficpms_icpTuning.description: Description of the approach used to optimise ICP plasma conditions prior to analysis, including the reference material used for tuning and the acceptance criteria (e.g., oxide production threshold, sensitivity targets, mass calibration).

laSficpms_instrumentSensitivity.title: Instrument Sensitivity
laSficpms_instrumentSensitivity.description: Instrument sensitivity achieved in the session, with the isotope or channel it was measured on and the conditions it applies to. May be expressed either as detected signal per unit concentration or per unit mass of analyte delivered — counts per second per ppb, volts per ppm, counts per picogram — or as useful yield, the percentage of sampled atoms ultimately detected as ions, with the method used to derive it cited. A sensitivity the procedure requires before analyses may begin belongs with the tuning acceptance criteria.

laSficpms_instrumentSerialNumberOrLabIde.title: Instrument Serial Number or Lab Identifier
laSficpms_instrumentSerialNumberOrLabIde.description: Serial number or laboratory-internal identifier for the specific instrument unit.

schema:name.const: Instrument Serial Number or Lab Identifier

laSficpms_instrumentWarmUpSessionDuratio.title: Instrument Warm-up / Session Duration Limit
laSficpms_instrumentWarmUpSessionDuratio.description: Minimum warm-up time required after plasma ignition before analyses begin, and any maximum session duration enforced to maintain stable operating conditions.

laSficpms_ionCounterDeadTime.title: Ion Counter Dead Time
laSficpms_ionCounterDeadTime.description: Dead time of each ion-counting detector channel, used in the dead-time correction applied to high count rates. Distinct from pulse/analog cross-calibration, which relates the two detector modes rather than correcting counting losses within the pulse-counting mode.

laSficpms_laserBeamEnergyProfile.title: Laser Beam Energy Profile
laSficpms_laserBeamEnergyProfile.description: Spatial energy distribution of the laser beam at the sample surface, and whether a beam homogenizer is installed.

laSficpms_laserEnergy.title: Laser Energy
laSficpms_laserEnergy.description: Laser pulse energy in millijoules as set at the laser output or measured at the sample surface. Report only when the system displays energy directly. Laser fluence (J cm⁻²) is the preferred quantity and is captured in Laser Fluence (Energy Density).

laSficpms_laserFluence.title: Laser Fluence (Energy Density)
laSficpms_laserFluence.description: Laser pulse energy per unit area at the sample surface in J cm⁻², as registered by the procedure. If the system reports only as % of maximum output, include that value and note the system maximum where known.

laSficpms_laserRepetitionRate.title: Laser Repetition Rate
laSficpms_laserRepetitionRate.description: Laser pulse repetition rate in hertz registered by the procedure.

laSficpms_laserSpotGeometry.title: Laser Spot Geometry
laSficpms_laserSpotGeometry.description: Shape and dimensions of the laser ablation spot in micrometres registered by the procedure. For circular spots, report diameter; for square or rectangular spots, report width × length.

laSficpms_makeUpGasAndFlowRate.title: Make-up Gas and Flow Rate
laSficpms_makeUpGasAndFlowRate.description: Supplementary gas added to the sample-carrying stream between the sample introduction system and the plasma, with its identity and the procedure-registered target flow rate. Record any small nitrogen or hydrogen addition with its own flow, whose unit commonly differs from the make-up flow. Record 'None' explicitly where no supplementary gas is added, to distinguish it from not reported.

laSficpms_massResolutionSetting.title: Mass Resolution Setting
laSficpms_massResolutionSetting.description: Operating mass resolution of the mass analyser. Where the analyser permits selection, state the mode; where individual analytes are assigned to different modes, state each.

laSficpms_matrixOffsetCorrection.title: Matrix Offset Correction (LIEF)
laSficpms_matrixOffsetCorrection.description: Whether an empirical correction was applied to account for systematic differences in laser-induced elemental fractionation (LIEF) patterns between the external calibration standard and the sample matrix.

laSficpms_memoryEffectMitigation.title: Memory Effect Mitigation
laSficpms_memoryEffectMitigation.description: Procedure applied to identify and minimise carry-over of high-concentration or isotopically distinct material from a preceding measurement into the current one. Mitigation is applied primarily at measurement time, by allowing sufficient washout or rinse between successive introductions. At data processing level, record any flagging or exclusion of measurements where the required washout may not have been achieved.

laSficpms_multiRunSequentialAnalysisDesi.title: Multi-Run Sequential Analysis Design
laSficpms_multiRunSequentialAnalysisDesi.description: Whether the procedure uses a single acquisition pass or multiple sequential runs on the same sample location, each optimized for different analytical objectives. For multi-run designs, describe the number of runs, their purpose, key laser and instrument settings per run, and how outputs of one run feed into data reduction of another. Not applicable to raster mapping, where each spatial location is visited exactly once.

laSficpms_normalizationStandardsBasedCor.title: Normalization / Standards-Based Correction
laSficpms_normalizationStandardsBasedCor.description: Post-acquisition normalization applied to the reported data beyond the primary calibration — for example correction to a reference value derived from secondary reference materials, or correction for a systematic bias those materials reveal. Record 'None' if no additional normalization is applied.

laSficpms_preAblationSurfaceTreatment.title: Pre-Ablation Surface Treatment
laSficpms_preAblationSurfaceTreatment.description: Procedure applied immediately before each analysis to remove surface contamination or condition the sample surface. Distinct from general sample preparation. For spot analysis, pre-ablation pulses are discarded before signal acquisition begins. For mapping, this step is typically omitted.

laSficpms_preAnalysisImagingAndScreening.title: Pre-Analysis Imaging and Screening
laSficpms_preAnalysisImagingAndScreening.description: Imaging or other characterisation performed before the measurement in order to select or locate the sampling unit to be analysed, including the technique, instrument and settings used, and how individual analyses are linked back to the images. Distinct from any imaging the procedure performs as its own measurement. Where the imaging is performed on a separate instrument, it should also be recorded in the Group 1 coupling fields.

laSficpms_primaryCalibrationStandardName.title: Primary Calibration Standard Name
laSficpms_primaryCalibrationStandardName.description: Name and reference material identifier of the primary reference material(s) against which the instrument is calibrated — converting raw signal intensities to concentrations, or anchoring an isotope ratio as the bracketing standard or zero-delta reference. Give the material name, its source or supplier, and a citation for the accepted values used. Where calibration instead uses the vendor's stored library or theoretical response factors rather than measured reference materials — 'standardless' or 'semi-quantitative' quantification — record that here, naming the library or model used. 'None' means no calibration was performed at all, which is a different answer.

laSficpms_pulseAnalogDetectorNonlinearit.title: Pulse/Analog Detector Nonlinearity Correction
laSficpms_pulseAnalogDetectorNonlinearit.description: Whether a correction was applied for nonlinear detector response at the transition between pulse-counting and analog (and Faraday, for triple-mode instruments) detection modes. Cross-calibration factors between detector modes must be confirmed, typically measured each session. Record 'Applied' and describe the method, the detector modes involved and the analytes affected; 'None' where a crossover exists on this instrument but no correction was made, giving the reason; and 'N/A' where the detector is pulse-counting only and no crossover exists.

laSficpms_rasterLineSpacing.title: Raster Line Spacing (Mapping Only)
laSficpms_rasterLineSpacing.description: Distance between adjacent raster lines in a 2D elemental map, measured perpendicular to the scan direction, in micrometres. Applies to raster mapping only.

laSficpms_rfPower.title: RF Power
laSficpms_rfPower.description: Radiofrequency forward power applied to the ICP, in watts.

laSficpms_sampleFormAnalyticalSubstrate.title: Sample Form / Analytical Substrate
laSficpms_sampleFormAnalyticalSubstrate.description: Physical form of the material as it enters the ablation cell. Variations that do not alter the analytical procedure (e.g., thin section vs. mount) are legitimate.

laSficpms_samplePersistentIdentifier.title: Sample Persistent Identifier
laSficpms_samplePersistentIdentifier.description: Globally unique, persistent identifier for each sample listed in Sample Name. IGSN (International Geo Sample Number) is the recommended standard for geological and cosmochemical samples, as used by Astromat, EarthChem and SESAR. Where a sample and its sub-samples are separately registered, record the identifier at the level actually analysed.

laSficpms_samplePreparationMethod.title: Sample Preparation Method
laSficpms_samplePreparationMethod.description: The form in which the sample is presented to the instrument, and the preparation that brought it to that form — for example mounting, sectioning, polishing, coating, crushing, fusion, or extraction of an electron-transparent section. Record 'None' where the material is analysed as received.

laSficpms_samplerAndSkimmerConeMaterial.title: Sampler and Skimmer Cone Material
laSficpms_samplerAndSkimmerConeMaterial.description: Material composition of the sampler and skimmer cones. State both sampler and skimmer materials; a single statement is acceptable where they are identical.

laSficpms_samplingUnitSelectionCriteria.title: Sampling Unit Selection Criteria
laSficpms_samplingUnitSelectionCriteria.description: The rules governing which sampling unit(s) within a sample are selected for analysis, and why. Covers the criteria applied when choosing grains, aliquots, spots, or a region of interest — size, morphology, clarity, freedom from inclusions or alteration, phase identity, or spatial position. Distinct from Target Material, which states the material type the procedure is designed for, and from Sampling Unit, which names the kind of subdivision one row of reported values corresponds to: this field states how, within such a sample, the unit actually analysed is picked out.

laSficpms_secondaryReferenceMaterials.title: Secondary Reference Materials
laSficpms_secondaryReferenceMaterials.description: Quality-control reference material(s) measured as unknowns alongside samples to assess accuracy independently and to monitor drift. Give the material name, its source, and a citation for the accepted or reference values used for comparison.

laSficpms_signalSmoothing.title: Signal Smoothing
laSficpms_signalSmoothing.description: Description of any signal smoothing device or approach installed between the ablation cell and the ICP-MS to reduce pulse-to-pulse signal variability. For mapping analyses, report "None" explicitly.

laSficpms_spikeOutlierFilteringApproach.title: Spike / Outlier Filtering Approach
laSficpms_spikeOutlierFilteringApproach.description: Criteria used to identify and exclude anomalous data - signal spikes, individual cycles, or whole replicate measurements - before the reported value is calculated. State where in the reduction sequence the filter is applied.

laSficpms_torchDepth.title: Torch Depth
laSficpms_torchDepth.description: Distance between the load coil and the sampling cone tip (mm), also called injector depth or torch position depending on the instrument manufacturer.

laSficpms_torchType.title: Torch Type
laSficpms_torchType.description: Type of plasma torch installed (e.g. standard quartz, high-matrix, low-flow).

laSficpms_totalIntegrationTimePerOutputD.title: Total Integration Time per Output Data Point
laSficpms_totalIntegrationTimePerOutputD.description: Total duty-cycle time for one complete mass-scan sweep — the sum of all per-isotope dwell times plus inter-mass settling times. Not recoverable from Dwell Time per Mass alone, because settling time is not captured there. Applies to sequential (quadrupole and single-collector sector-field) acquisition.

schema:name.const: Total Integration Time per Output Data Point

laSficpms_transectRateMappingRateOrStepS.title: Transect Rate, Mapping Rate or Step Size
laSficpms_transectRateMappingRateOrStepS.description: For continuous line scan (transect) and raster mapping: the stage translation speed in µm s⁻¹. For mapping, the mapping rate (mm² h⁻¹) may be reported as an alternative when scan speed is session-variable. For stepped line profiles: the distance between successive spot positions in µm.

schema:name.const: Transect Rate, Mapping Rate or Step Size

laSficpms_tripleScanningMode.title: Triple Scanning Mode
laSficpms_tripleScanningMode.description: Whether each mass peak is scanned three times per cycle and the results averaged (Y/N). Record 'N/A' if not applicable to the instrument.

laSficpms_uncertaintyPropagationMethod.title: Uncertainty Propagation Method
laSficpms_uncertaintyPropagationMethod.description: The approach used to propagate analytical uncertainty through the data reduction chain to the final reported value. State which sources are included in the propagation: counting statistics, calibration standard uncertainty, internal standard uncertainty, drift correction, and any systematic contributions. Distinct from Uncertainty Level, which states the convention at which the resulting uncertainty is quoted.

labxct_acceleratingVoltage.title: Accelerating Voltage
labxct_acceleratingVoltage.description: X-ray tube accelerating voltage in kilovolts (kV). If the voltage was varied across samples within the same procedure or session, report the full range applied (e.g., 90–115 kV). Note: some sources report this parameter as 'X keV' (maximum Bremsstrahlung photon energy) rather than 'X kV' (tube voltage). For polychromatic lab XCT, these are numerically equivalent: E_max [keV] = V [kV]. Record the value as originally reported, and add a parenthetical note if the unit used is keV.

labxct_beamHardeningArtifactAssessment.title: Beam Hardening Artifact Assessment
labxct_beamHardeningArtifactAssessment.description: Assessment of whether residual beam hardening (cupping artifact) is present in the reconstructed volume after any corrections applied during reconstruction. Record whether this artifact is detectable in the final dataset, what correction or mitigation was applied (e.g., linearisation, pre-filtering, iterative correction), and whether any residual effect influences the analysis region.

labxct_beamHardeningCorrectionParameter.title: Beam Hardening Correction Parameter
labxct_beamHardeningCorrectionParameter.description: Numerical value or setting applied in the software beam hardening correction algorithm for this specific analysis. Companion to Beam Hardening Correction Method.

labxct_calibrationFactorAndDetermination.title: Calibration Factor and Determination Method
labxct_calibrationFactorAndDetermination.description: An externally-calibrated factor that converts the measured quantity into the reported quantity, how it was determined, and its uncertainty. Applies where the conversion depends on a factor calibrated against a reference of independently known value, rather than on the instrument response alone. Distinct from the fields that name the calibration material and that state which approach applies to which analyte, where the technique has them: this field records the resulting factor itself.

labxct_constantsAndReferenceValuesUsed.title: Constants and Reference Values Used
labxct_constantsAndReferenceValuesUsed.description: Physical constants and reference values used in data reduction to calculate the final reported quantity (e.g., decay constants for age calculation, standard isotope ratios, or other citable reference values used in a correction or calculation), together with their source. Distinct from the Group 6 reference-material fields, which document accepted values for specific calibration/validation materials rather than universal physical constants. Record "None" if no citable, revisable physical constants feed into this procedure's data reduction.

labxct_coupledDatasetOrPublicationRefere.title: Coupled Dataset or Publication Reference
labxct_coupledDatasetOrPublicationRefere.description: DOI or other persistent identifier for the co-registered dataset or publication where both datasets are reported together. Accepts: a dedicated dataset DOI (if separately deposited), a shared dataset DOI (if co-submitted in the same package), or a publication DOI. Use "same submission" if the coupled dataset is included in this data package, or "pending" if not yet assigned. If coupling is documented through a shared sample identifier only, that information is already captured in Sample Persistent Identifier (Group 2).

labxct_coupledProcedureDoi.title: Coupled Procedure DOI
labxct_coupledProcedureDoi.description: Registered procedure DOI for the coupled technique named above. If the coupled procedure has not yet been registered, enter the DOI of a publication describing the coupled method, or "pending". Enter "None" if no coupling is planned.

labxct_crossValidationOutcome.title: Cross-Validation Outcome
labxct_crossValidationOutcome.description: Record of what independent validation was performed and its result. Report the validation method(s) used, the quantitative agreement achieved (e.g., relative difference in modal abundance, porosity), and any discrepancies and their likely causes. Where BSE imaging is the validation method, note that BSE provides a 2D section while CT provides a 3D volume.

labxct_crossValidationProcedureRequireme.title: Cross-Validation Procedure Requirement
labxct_crossValidationProcedureRequireme.description: Specification of what independent analytical validation is required to confirm CT segmentation results, phase identification, or quantitative measurements. Common approaches include BSE imaging, SEM-EDS or EPMA modal analysis, He pycnometry for bulk porosity, and Raman or SIMS phase mapping. Record the required validation method(s) and the sampling fraction (e.g., every sample, one per session, or a representative subset).

labxct_ctNumberCalibration.title: CT Number Calibration
labxct_ctNumberCalibration.description: Whether the raw CT grayscale values have been calibrated to physically meaningful units using reference materials.

labxct_dataProcessingSoftware.title: Data Processing Software(s)
labxct_dataProcessingSoftware.description: All software applied to the data after acquisition in order to produce the reported quantities, including version numbers. List every package used. Distinct from Acquisition Software, which controls the instrument and collects the raw data.

labxct_detectorArraySize.title: Detector Array Size
labxct_detectorArraySize.description: Number of pixels in the detector array (width × height).

labxct_detectorBinning.title: Detector Binning
labxct_detectorBinning.description: Detector pixel binning factor applied during acquisition. Binning combines adjacent pixels (e.g., 2×2 combines 4 pixels into one).

labxct_detectorPixelSize.title: Detector Pixel Size
labxct_detectorPixelSize.description: Physical size of a single pixel on the detector in micrometres. This is a fixed hardware property of the detector array, distinct from the reconstructed voxel size (which depends on geometric magnification and binning).

labxct_effectiveSpatialResolution.title: Effective Spatial Resolution (PSF/MTF)
labxct_effectiveSpatialResolution.description: Effective spatial resolution of the reconstructed CT volume, which typically differs from (and is coarser than) the voxel size due to the detector point spread function (PSF), geometric unsharpness, and the reconstruction filter. Formal measurement uses the PSF method described in Ketcham & Hildebrandt (2014) or the modulation transfer function (MTF); resolution can also be reported per ASTM E1441-11. When formal measurement is unavailable, an estimate based on acquisition geometry (e.g., the Brenner-Weiss formula) or a stated multiple of the voxel size may be recorded. Report the value in µm along with the method used to determine or estimate it. Note that most XCT papers use the bare phrase "spatial resolution" for the voxel size; record that under Voxel Size, and leave this field as not reported unless an effective resolution was actually determined.

labxct_exposureTimePerProjection.title: Exposure Time per Projection
labxct_exposureTimePerProjection.description: Duration of X-ray exposure for each individual projection image frame, in seconds. Adjustment is warranted for samples that are unusually dense or unusually transparent. If the exposure time was varied across samples within the same procedure or session, report the full range applied (e.g., 0.5–2 s).

labxct_flatFieldCorrection.title: Flat Field Correction
labxct_flatFieldCorrection.description: Whether dark-field (detector read with X-ray source off; electronic noise baseline) and bright-field (source on, no sample; gain calibration) reference images are acquired and applied to normalize detector response before reconstruction.

labxct_framesAveragedPerProjection.title: Frames Averaged per Projection
labxct_framesAveragedPerProjection.description: Number of individual detector frames acquired and averaged to produce each saved projection image. The effective exposure per projection = exposure time per frame × frames averaged.

labxct_metalStreakArtifactAssessment.title: Metal Streak Artifact Assessment
labxct_metalStreakArtifactAssessment.description: Assessment of whether high-density inclusions (FeNi metal, platinum-group minerals, dense oxides, or other high-Z phases) produce streak or starburst artifacts in the reconstructed volume. Common forms include radial starburst streaks from high-Z inclusions and shadowing (anomalously low CT number) in beam-shadow regions behind dense phases. Record which artifact type(s) are present, their spatial extent, and any exclusion zones or correction steps applied.

labxct_numberOfProjections.title: Number of Projections
labxct_numberOfProjections.description: Total number of equally-spaced projection images acquired over the full rotation range. For Mode B (multi-volume stitching), this is the number per sub-volume.

labxct_opticalObjective.title: Optical Objective
labxct_opticalObjective.description: Optical magnification objective installed between the scintillator and CCD/CMOS detector. Applies only to instruments using optical magnification (e.g., Zeiss Xradia Versa series). For systems using only geometric magnification, report "Not applicable".

labxct_outputBitDepth.title: Output Bit Depth
labxct_outputBitDepth.description: Bit depth of the reconstructed 3D volume (number of bits used to encode each voxel's grayscale value). Common values are 8-bit (256 gray levels), 16-bit (65,536 gray levels), or 32-bit floating point. A required output bit depth may be specified if downstream analysis workflows depend on a consistent grayscale range.

labxct_outputDataFormat.title: Output Data Format
labxct_outputDataFormat.description: File format of the reconstructed CT volume as output by the reconstruction software. Bit depth is recorded separately in Output Bit Depth.

labxct_partialVolumeEffectAssessment.title: Partial Volume Effect Assessment
labxct_partialVolumeEffectAssessment.description: Record of PVE severity and how it was handled. Documents the minimum feature size relative to the voxel size, the fraction of the feature population affected, and any PVE correction method applied (e.g., PSF-based deconvolution via Blob3D).

labxct_partialVolumeEffectCriteria.title: Partial Volume Effect Criteria
labxct_partialVolumeEffectCriteria.description: Specification of how partial volume effects (PVE) are managed in quantitative analysis. PVE correction can be implemented via PSF-based deconvolution tools such as Blob3D. Record the minimum feature size criterion adopted for the procedure (in voxels or µm), the basis for it, the treatment of boundary voxels in modal abundance or size distribution calculations, and whether PVE correction is required or optional. State whether the criterion follows the Withers et al. (2021) convention — a feature must span at least 3 voxels to be positively identified and at least 10 for reliable shape and volume characterisation — or is SNR-limited, PVE-limited or analyst-defined.

labxct_phaseIdentificationMethod.title: Phase Identification Method
labxct_phaseIdentificationMethod.description: Method used to assign reconstructed CT number ranges to specific mineral phases or material types. Approaches include comparison to calculated linear attenuation coefficients (LAC), cross-validation with independent analytical techniques, or empirical calibration.

labxct_preAnalysisImagingAndScreening.title: Pre-Analysis Imaging and Screening
labxct_preAnalysisImagingAndScreening.description: Imaging or other characterisation performed before the measurement in order to select or locate the sampling unit to be analysed, including the technique, instrument and settings used, and how individual analyses are linked back to the images. Distinct from any imaging the procedure performs as its own measurement. Where the imaging is performed on a separate instrument, it should also be recorded in the Group 1 coupling fields.

labxct_reconstructionConvolutionFilter.title: Reconstruction Convolution Filter
labxct_reconstructionConvolutionFilter.description: Convolution (apodization) filter kernel applied during back-projection reconstruction.

labxct_reconstructionSoftware.title: Reconstruction Software
labxct_reconstructionSoftware.description: Software used to reconstruct 2D projection images into a 3D CT volume, including version number.

labxct_ringArtifactCorrectionMethod.title: Ring Artifact Correction Method
labxct_ringArtifactCorrectionMethod.description: Procedure specification for how ring artifacts are handled. Whether correction was applied and its outcome are recorded separately in Group 6.

labxct_ringArtifactSeverityAndCorrection.title: Ring Artifact Severity and Correction Outcome
labxct_ringArtifactSeverityAndCorrection.description: Assessment of whether ring artifacts — concentric rings centred on the rotation axis arising from differential sensitivity or gain drift among detector elements — were present and whether correction was effective. Note that ring correction algorithms modify image intensity in narrow annular bands. Record whether rings were present, whether correction was applied, and whether any residual rings or correction artifacts fall within the analysis volume of interest.

schema:name.const: Ring Artifact Severity and Correction Outcome

labxct_rotationMode.title: Rotation Mode
labxct_rotationMode.description: Whether projection images are acquired during continuous sample rotation (faster; may introduce slight motion blur at high rotation speeds) or at discrete step positions with the stage stationary during each exposure (stop-and-shoot; eliminates motion blur).

labxct_rotationRange.title: Rotation Range
labxct_rotationRange.description: Total angular range over which projection images are acquired, in degrees.

labxct_rotationStepSize.title: Rotation Step Size
labxct_rotationStepSize.description: Angular increment between successive projection images, in degrees. Equal to Rotation Range divided by Number of Projections when both are reported; however, some sources report step size as the primary rotation parameter without stating the total number of projections explicitly.

labxct_sampleMass.title: Sample Mass
labxct_sampleMass.description: Mass of the sample in grams, recorded for curatorial tracking of precious or limited materials.

labxct_sampleMountingMethod.title: Sample Mounting Method
labxct_sampleMountingMethod.description: Method used to mount or hold the sample on the instrument rotation stage. Mounting material should transmit X-rays at the selected voltage without dominating beam attenuation. Report the holder CLASS from the list and name the specific vessel or material alongside it — 'Tube or vial — 1 cm plastic straw', not 'Tube or vial'. Where the sample is sealed or bagged inside a further holder for contamination control, record both layers. Report any adhesive, support material and alignment aids used.

labxct_samplePersistentIdentifier.title: Sample Persistent Identifier
labxct_samplePersistentIdentifier.description: Globally unique, persistent identifier for each sample listed in Sample Name. IGSN (International Geo Sample Number) is the recommended standard for geological and cosmochemical samples, as used by Astromat, EarthChem and SESAR. Where a sample and its sub-samples are separately registered, record the identifier at the level actually analysed.

labxct_samplePreparationMethod.title: Sample Preparation Method
labxct_samplePreparationMethod.description: The form in which the sample is presented to the instrument, and the preparation that brought it to that form — for example mounting, sectioning, polishing, coating, crushing, fusion, or extraction of an electron-transparent section. Record 'None' where the material is analysed as received.

labxct_samplePreparationNotes.title: Sample Preparation Notes
labxct_samplePreparationNotes.description: Any preparation steps applied to the sample before scanning, including cleaning, trimming, consolidation, or drying. Note any exceptions.

labxct_samplingUnitSelectionCriteria.title: Sampling Unit Selection Criteria
labxct_samplingUnitSelectionCriteria.description: The rules governing which sampling unit(s) within a sample are selected for analysis, and why. Covers the criteria applied when choosing grains, aliquots, spots, or a region of interest — size, morphology, clarity, freedom from inclusions or alteration, phase identity, or spatial position. Distinct from Target Material, which states the material type the procedure is designed for, and from Sampling Unit, which names the kind of subdivision one row of reported values corresponds to: this field states how, within such a sample, the unit actually analysed is picked out.

labxct_segmentationMethod.title: Segmentation Method
labxct_segmentationMethod.description: Method and software used to separate distinct phases or features in the reconstructed 3D volume, turning the grayscale volume into labelled regions.

labxct_segmentationThresholdValuesOrCrit.title: Segmentation Threshold Values or Criteria
labxct_segmentationThresholdValuesOrCrit.description: Specific CT number range(s) or quantitative criteria used to define each segmented phase or feature. For LAC-calibrated datasets, report values in cm⁻¹.

labxct_signalToNoiseRatio.title: Signal-to-Noise Ratio
labxct_signalToNoiseRatio.description: Quantitative measure of image quality in the reconstructed CT volume. Typically calculated as the mean CT number divided by the standard deviation of CT number in a homogeneous reference region (e.g., an inclusion-free zone of the matrix). Record the measured value and the region used for measurement, or note if SNR was not formally measured.

labxct_sourceToDetectorDistance.title: Source-to-Detector Distance (SDD)
labxct_sourceToDetectorDistance.description: Distance from the X-ray source focal spot to the detector surface, in mm. Voxel size ≈ detector pixel size / M (before binning; divide additionally by optical objective for Versa-class systems).

labxct_sourceToObjectDistance.title: Source-to-Object Distance (SOD)
labxct_sourceToObjectDistance.description: Distance from the X-ray source focal spot to the centre of the sample rotation axis, in mm.

labxct_subVolumeStitchingAndRegistration.title: Sub-volume Stitching and Registration Method
labxct_subVolumeStitchingAndRegistration.description: Method used to register adjacent sub-volume datasets to each other and stitch them into a single continuous 3D volume. Report the alignment strategy (manual, automated, fiducial-based), the software used, and any correction steps applied. Where rotational mismatch has been corrected via raw projection re-alignment, document it here.

labxct_totalScanDuration.title: Total Scan Duration
labxct_totalScanDuration.description: Total elapsed time for the complete XCT acquisition, from the start of the first projection to the end of the last. For multi-volume acquisitions, this is the combined scan time across all sub-volumes (not including setup or reconstruction time).

labxct_tubeCurrent.title: Tube Current
labxct_tubeCurrent.description: X-ray tube current in microamperes (µA). If the current was varied across samples within the same procedure or session, report the full range applied (e.g., 65–115 µA).

labxct_voiSelectionCriteria.title: VOI Selection Criteria
labxct_voiSelectionCriteria.description: Rules specifying how the Volume of Interest (VOI) is to be defined for quantitative analysis. Common criteria exclude cone-beam artifact zones at sample edges, beam hardening halos near dense inclusions, and sample holder signal. The actual VOI applied in a specific analysis is recorded separately at analysis level.

labxct_voxelSize.title: Voxel Size
labxct_voxelSize.description: Isotropic voxel edge length of the reconstructed 3D volume in micrometres. The target voxel size is set based on the smallest feature to be resolved (target voxel size ≤ ~1/3 of that feature size; see the criterion recorded under Partial Volume Effect Criteria). Record the achieved voxel size as reported by the reconstruction software, which may differ slightly from the target due to final geometric calibration.

labxct_xRayPower.title: X-ray Power
labxct_xRayPower.description: X-ray tube power in watts (W). Derivable as voltage (kV) × current (mA) = kV × µA / 1000. If power was varied across samples within the session, report the full range applied (e.g., 7–13 W).

labxct_xRayPreFilter.title: X-ray Pre-filter
labxct_xRayPreFilter.description: Material and thickness of the beam-hardening filter placed between the X-ray source and the sample. Both filter material and thickness must be reported. Instrument-proprietary filter codes should be decoded where possible.

labxct_xRayTubeAnodeMaterial.title: X-ray Tube Anode Material
labxct_xRayTubeAnodeMaterial.description: Material of the X-ray tube anode (target).

semComposition_acceleratingVoltage.title: Accelerating Voltage
semComposition_acceleratingVoltage.description: Electron beam accelerating voltage in kilovolts.

semComposition_analyteEstimationMethod.title: Analyte Estimation Method
semComposition_analyteEstimationMethod.description: Whether elemental concentrations were calculated directly from measured X-ray intensities, or estimated by cation stoichiometry (e.g., oxygen calculated from cation proportions in silicates; carbon from stoichiometry in carbonates).

semComposition_backgroundCountingTime.title: Background Counting Time
semComposition_backgroundCountingTime.description: Total time spent counting at off-peak background position(s) in seconds, summed across all background positions.

semComposition_backgroundPosition.title: Background Position(s)
semComposition_backgroundPosition.description: Location(s) of off-peak background measurement(s) relative to the peak, in mm or sin-theta, and whether on the high- or low-energy side.

semComposition_beamCurrent.title: Beam Current
semComposition_beamCurrent.description: Electron beam probe current. For sub-nA values use decimal notation (e.g., 0.4 nA).

semComposition_beamDamageMinimization.title: Beam Damage Minimization
semComposition_beamDamageMinimization.description: Describes any measures taken to reduce electron beam damage to the sample during analysis. Examples: reduced accelerating voltage, lowered beam current, defocused or rastered beam, cooled stage, short acquisition sequences, or rotating between multiple points.

semComposition_beamDiameter.title: Beam Diameter
semComposition_beamDiameter.description: Nominal electron beam diameter (spot size) at the sample surface, in nanometres or micrometres, as set by the condenser aperture and working distance. For mapping modes, the effective spatial sampling interval is further defined by Step Size / Pixel Size.

semComposition_beamRasterDimensions.title: Beam Raster Dimensions
semComposition_beamRasterDimensions.description: Dimensions of the small area over which the beam is rastered at a single analysis point, reported as width × height in µm. Applicable when Beam Mode = Rastered; defines the effective spatial footprint of the measurement. Not applicable when mapping.

semComposition_blankCorrection.title: Blank Correction
semComposition_blankCorrection.description: Method and reference material(s) used to determine and subtract blank signal contributions (e.g., carbon coat contribution to C signal, or background contamination for trace elements).

semComposition_calibrationFactorAndDeter.title: Calibration Factor and Determination Method
semComposition_calibrationFactorAndDeter.description: An externally-calibrated factor that converts the measured quantity into the reported quantity, how it was determined, and its uncertainty. Applies where the conversion depends on a factor calibrated against a reference of independently known value, rather than on the instrument response alone. Distinct from the fields that name the calibration material and that state which approach applies to which analyte, where the technique has them: this field records the resulting factor itself.

semComposition_chamberPressure.title: Chamber Pressure
semComposition_chamberPressure.description: Chamber pressure and gas type during analysis. Required for variable pressure (VP-SEM) and environmental SEM (ESEM) modes. Report value and unit (Pa or Torr) and gas composition. Use 'None' for standard high-vacuum operation.

semComposition_constantsAndReferenceValu.title: Constants and Reference Values Used
semComposition_constantsAndReferenceValu.description: Physical constants and reference values used in data reduction to calculate the final reported quantity (e.g., decay constants for age calculation, standard isotope ratios, or other citable reference values used in a correction or calculation), together with their source. Distinct from the Group 6 reference-material fields, which document accepted values for specific calibration/validation materials rather than universal physical constants. Record "None" if no citable, revisable physical constants feed into this procedure's data reduction.

semComposition_coupledDatasetOrPublicati.title: Coupled Dataset or Publication Reference
semComposition_coupledDatasetOrPublicati.description: DOI or other persistent identifier for the co-registered dataset or publication where both datasets are reported together. Accepts: a dedicated dataset DOI (if separately deposited), a shared dataset DOI (if co-submitted in the same package), or a publication DOI. Use "same submission" if the coupled dataset is included in this data package, or "pending" if not yet assigned. If coupling is documented through a shared sample identifier only, that information is already captured in Sample Persistent Identifier (Group 2).

semComposition_coupledProcedureDoi.title: Coupled Procedure DOI
semComposition_coupledProcedureDoi.description: Registered procedure DOI for the coupled technique named above. If the coupled procedure has not yet been registered, enter the DOI of a publication describing the coupled method, or "pending". Enter "None" if no coupling is planned.

semComposition_dataProcessingSoftware.title: Data Processing Software(s)
semComposition_dataProcessingSoftware.description: All software applied to the data after acquisition in order to produce the reported quantities, including version numbers. List every package used. Distinct from Acquisition Software, which controls the instrument and collects the raw data.

semComposition_driftCorrection.title: Drift Correction
semComposition_driftCorrection.description: Describes whether and how stage or beam drift was monitored and corrected during the measurement session. Examples: periodic stage realignment to a fiducial marker, automated beam drift correction in acquisition software, or reanalysis of a reference point at regular intervals.

semComposition_dwellTimePerPixel.title: Dwell Time per Pixel
semComposition_dwellTimePerPixel.description: Time the electron beam dwells on each pixel during raster scanning (imaging modes) or on each step position during compositional mapping (EDS and WDS mapping modes), in microseconds or milliseconds. For WDS mapping, the dwell time is per spectrometer per pixel.

semComposition_edsDetectorConfiguration.title: EDS Detector Configuration
semComposition_edsDetectorConfiguration.description: EDS detector type, manufacturer, number of detector elements, active area and solid angle, window type, and geometry (take-off angle, position). List multiple detectors separately. Record 'N/A' where the procedure has no EDS detector.

semComposition_edsLiveTimePerPointOrPixe.title: EDS Live Time per Point or Pixel
semComposition_edsLiveTimePerPointOrPixe.description: EDS spectral acquisition live time per analysis point or per pixel in seconds.

schema:name.const: EDS Live Time per Point or Pixel

semComposition_edsSpectralProcessingType.title: EDS Spectral Processing Type
semComposition_edsSpectralProcessingType.description: Method used to process EDS spectra and extract net peak intensities from raw spectral data. Applied before quantification (see Matrix Correction Method). Common approaches include background fitting and subtraction followed by peak integration, and filter fit or Gaussian deconvolution for overlapping peaks.

semComposition_halogenCorrectionOnOxygen.title: Halogen Correction on Oxygen
semComposition_halogenCorrectionOnOxygen.description: Whether oxygen content was adjusted to account for halogen substitution (F and/or Cl replacing OH) in halogen-bearing phases such as apatite, amphibole, and mica, where oxygen is calculated by stoichiometry.

semComposition_interferenceCorrectionSta.title: Interference Correction Standard
semComposition_interferenceCorrectionSta.description: Reference material used to quantify and calibrate the interference correction.

semComposition_interferingElements.title: Interfering Elements
semComposition_interferingElements.description: Element(s) whose X-ray lines overlap with the measured peak, requiring a correction.

semComposition_normalizationStandardsBas.title: Normalization / Standards-Based Correction
semComposition_normalizationStandardsBas.description: Post-acquisition normalization applied to the reported data beyond the primary calibration — for example correction to a reference value derived from secondary reference materials, or correction for a systematic bias those materials reveal. Record 'None' if no additional normalization is applied.

semComposition_peakCountingTime.title: Peak Counting Time
semComposition_peakCountingTime.description: Time spent counting X-ray intensity at the peak position, in seconds. Adjustments stay within procedure-defined bounds.

semComposition_preAnalysisImagingAndScre.title: Pre-Analysis Imaging and Screening
semComposition_preAnalysisImagingAndScre.description: Imaging or other characterisation performed before the measurement in order to select or locate the sampling unit to be analysed, including the technique, instrument and settings used, and how individual analyses are linked back to the images. Distinct from any imaging the procedure performs as its own measurement. Where the imaging is performed on a separate instrument, it should also be recorded in the Group 1 coupling fields.

semComposition_primaryCalibrationStandar.title: Primary Calibration Standard Name
semComposition_primaryCalibrationStandar.description: Name and reference material identifier of the primary reference material(s) against which the instrument is calibrated — converting raw signal intensities to concentrations, or anchoring an isotope ratio as the bracketing standard or zero-delta reference. Give the material name, its source or supplier, and a citation for the accepted values used. Where calibration instead uses the vendor's stored library or theoretical response factors rather than measured reference materials — 'standardless' or 'semi-quantitative' quantification — record that here, naming the library or model used. 'None' means no calibration was performed at all, which is a different answer.

semComposition_samplePersistentIdentifie.title: Sample Persistent Identifier
semComposition_samplePersistentIdentifie.description: Globally unique, persistent identifier for each sample listed in Sample Name. IGSN (International Geo Sample Number) is the recommended standard for geological and cosmochemical samples, as used by Astromat, EarthChem and SESAR. Where a sample and its sub-samples are separately registered, record the identifier at the level actually analysed.

semComposition_samplePreparationMethod.title: Sample Preparation Method
semComposition_samplePreparationMethod.description: The form in which the sample is presented to the instrument, and the preparation that brought it to that form — for example mounting, sectioning, polishing, coating, crushing, fusion, or extraction of an electron-transparent section. Record 'None' where the material is analysed as received.

semComposition_samplingUnitSelectionCrit.title: Sampling Unit Selection Criteria
semComposition_samplingUnitSelectionCrit.description: The rules governing which sampling unit(s) within a sample are selected for analysis, and why. semComposition_secondaryReferenceMateria.title: Secondary Reference Materials
semComposition_secondaryReferenceMateria.description: Quality-control reference material(s) measured as unknowns alongside samples to assess accuracy independently and to monitor drift. Give the material name, its source, and a citation for the accepted or reference values used for comparison.

semComposition_sequence.title: Sequence
semComposition_sequence.description: Order in which spectrometer assignments are acquired during point analysis. Not applicable to X-ray mapping, where all assigned spectrometers collect simultaneously at each pixel.

semComposition_stageScanVsBeamScan.title: Stage Scan vs. Beam Scan
semComposition_stageScanVsBeamScan.description: For mapping modes, whether the map was acquired by moving the stage while the beam is held fixed (stage scan), or by deflecting the beam across the field while the stage is stationary (beam scan).

semComposition_stepSizePixelSize.title: Step Size / Pixel Size
semComposition_stepSizePixelSize.description: Centre-to-centre distance between adjacent measurement points (WDS mapping) or pixels (EDS mapping) in µm.

semComposition_timeDependentIntensityCor.title: Time-Dependent Intensity Correction
semComposition_timeDependentIntensityCor.description: Type of time-dependent intensity (TDI) correction applied to compensate for beam-induced volatilisation or migration of sensitive elements (e.g., Na, K, F in glasses, feldspars, carbonates).

semComposition_wdsPhaSetting.title: WDS PHA Setting
semComposition_wdsPhaSetting.description: Pulse height analyzer (PHA) setting for the WDS detector. Integral mode accepts all pulses above a threshold; Differential mode selects a narrow energy window to reject higher-order reflections and escape peaks.

semComposition_wdsSpectrometerChannel.title: WDS Spectrometer Channel
semComposition_wdsSpectrometerChannel.description: WDS spectrometer position(s) assigned to each analyte, one entry per assignment. An analyte may be assigned to more than one spectrometer with intensities aggregated (aggregate intensity counting), and one spectrometer serves several analytes across a run, so the assignment — not the analyte — is the unit carrying the spectrometer setup.

semComposition_wdsSpectrometerConfigurat.title: WDS Spectrometer Configuration
semComposition_wdsSpectrometerConfigurat.description: Number, type, and crystal range of WDS spectrometers on the instrument. Include manufacturer, model, and crystal range. For SEM-WDS configurations (third-party WDS on a non-EPMA platform), include WDS manufacturer and model.

semComposition_workingDistance.title: Working Distance
semComposition_workingDistance.description: Distance between the objective lens pole piece and the specimen surface in millimetres.

semComposition_xRayBackgroundCorrectionM.title: X-ray Background Correction Method
semComposition_xRayBackgroundCorrectionM.description: Method used to estimate and subtract background X-ray intensity beneath the peak. For WDS: typically 2-point off-peak linear interpolation or Mean Atomic Number (MAN) background model. For EDS: spectral background fitting or top-hat filter applied during spectral processing.

semFibsem_acceleratingVoltage.title: Accelerating Voltage
semFibsem_acceleratingVoltage.description: Electron beam accelerating voltage in kilovolts.

semFibsem_beamCurrent.title: Beam Current
semFibsem_beamCurrent.description: Electron beam probe current. For sub-nA values use decimal notation (e.g., 0.4 nA).

semFibsem_coarseMillingConditions.title: Coarse Milling Conditions
semFibsem_coarseMillingConditions.description: Ion beam voltage and current used for bulk material removal during FIB milling. For TEM specimen preparation: bulk trenching to isolate the lamella and intermediate thinning. For 3D tomography: face preparation and initial slice removal.

semFibsem_dwellTimePerPixel.title: Dwell Time per Pixel
semFibsem_dwellTimePerPixel.description: Time the electron beam dwells on each pixel during raster scanning, or on each step position during mapping, in microseconds or milliseconds.

semFibsem_finePolishingConditions.title: Fine Polishing Conditions
semFibsem_finePolishingConditions.description: Ion beam voltage and current for final thinning and surface polishing of the TEM lamella.

semFibsem_foilThickness.title: Foil Thickness
semFibsem_foilThickness.description: Target thickness of the electron-transparent TEM lamella after final FIB polishing, in nanometres. Actual thickness may differ from target.

semFibsem_imageRegistration3D.title: 3D Image Registration
semFibsem_imageRegistration3D.description: Method used to align consecutive SEM image slices in the 3D stack to correct for drift, vibration, and curtaining artifacts. Include software used.

semFibsem_ionMillingConditions.title: Ion Milling Conditions (3D Tomography)
semFibsem_ionMillingConditions.description: Ion beam voltage and current used to mill each slice during FIB-SEM serial sectioning.

semFibsem_preAnalysisImagingAndScreening.title: Pre-Analysis Imaging and Screening
semFibsem_preAnalysisImagingAndScreening.description: Imaging or other characterisation performed before the measurement in order to select or locate the sampling unit to be analysed, including the technique, instrument and settings used, and how individual analyses are linked back to the images. semFibsem_protectiveCoatingDeposition.title: Protective Coating Deposition
semFibsem_protectiveCoatingDeposition.description: Type and deposition conditions of the protective coating applied to the sample surface before FIB milling. E-beam deposition should be applied as the initial layer. Typical coatings: platinum (Pt) or carbon (C). State material, deposition method, beam conditions, and approximate thickness.

semFibsem_segmentationMethod.description: Method and software used to separate distinct phases or features in the reconstructed 3D volume, turning the grayscale volume into labelled regions.

semFibsem_sliceThickness.title: Slice Thickness
semFibsem_sliceThickness.description: Thickness of each FIB-milled slice during serial sectioning in nanometres.

semFibsem_workingDistance.title: Working Distance
semFibsem_workingDistance.description: Distance between the objective lens pole piece and the specimen surface in millimetres.

semImaging_acceleratingVoltage.title: Accelerating Voltage
semImaging_acceleratingVoltage.description: Electron beam accelerating voltage in kilovolts.

semImaging_beamCurrent.title: Beam Current
semImaging_beamCurrent.description: Electron beam probe current. For sub-nA values use decimal notation (e.g., 0.4 nA).

semImaging_chamberPressure.title: Chamber Pressure
semImaging_chamberPressure.description: Chamber pressure and gas type during analysis. Required for variable pressure (VP-SEM) and environmental SEM (ESEM) modes. Report value and unit (Pa or Torr) and gas composition. Use 'None' for standard high-vacuum operation.

semImaging_clDetectorConfiguration.title: CL Detector Configuration
semImaging_clDetectorConfiguration.description: CL detector type, manufacturer, model, collection optics (e.g., parabolic mirror, elliptical mirror, light guide), and spectral detection configuration (PMT for panchromatic, CCD/EMCCD for spectral, multi-channel for pseudo-color CL).

semImaging_clGrating.title: CL Grating
semImaging_clGrating.description: Diffraction grating specification for spectral or hyperspectral CL acquisition, including groove density and blaze wavelength. Not applicable to panchromatic-only acquisition.

semImaging_clIntegrationTime.title: CL Integration Time
semImaging_clIntegrationTime.description: Acquisition time per pixel (hyperspectral map mode) or per spectrum (spectral point mode), in ms or s.

semImaging_clWavelengthCalibrationRefere.title: CL Wavelength Calibration Reference
semImaging_clWavelengthCalibrationRefere.description: Reference light source or standard material used to calibrate the wavelength axis of the CL spectrometer. Required for quantitative spectral CL and hyperspectral mapping.

semImaging_crystalStructureDatabase.title: Crystal Structure Database
semImaging_crystalStructureDatabase.description: Crystal structure database used for EBSD phase identification and Kikuchi pattern simulation.

semImaging_dataProcessingSoftware.title: Data Processing Software(s)
semImaging_dataProcessingSoftware.description: All software applied to the data after acquisition in order to produce the reported quantities, including version numbers. List every package used. Distinct from Acquisition Software, which controls the instrument and collects the raw data.

semImaging_dwellTimePerPixel.title: Dwell Time per Pixel
