semImaging_ebsdFrameTime.title: EBSD Frame Time
semImaging_ebsdFrameTime.description: Acquisition time per EBSD diffraction pattern frame in milliseconds.

semImaging_ebsdPatternQualityThreshold.title: EBSD Pattern Quality Threshold
semImaging_ebsdPatternQualityThreshold.description: Minimum pattern quality or confidence index threshold applied during EBSD data processing to exclude unreliably indexed points from orientation maps. Include metric name and threshold value.

semImaging_ebsdPhaseList.title: EBSD Phase List
semImaging_ebsdPhaseList.description: Mineral phases included in the EBSD reference pattern library for this procedure. Phases may be added for specific sample compositions beyond the expected suite for the target material.

semImaging_ebsdStepSize.title: EBSD Step Size
semImaging_ebsdStepSize.description: Distance between adjacent EBSD measurement points in the map in nm or µm. Must be smaller than the smallest grain of interest.

semImaging_preAnalysisImagingAndScreenin.title: Pre-Analysis Imaging and Screening
semImaging_preAnalysisImagingAndScreenin.description: Imaging or other characterisation performed before the measurement in order to select or locate the sampling unit to be analysed, including the technique, instrument and settings used, and how individual analyses are linked back to the images. Distinct from any imaging the procedure performs as its own measurement. Where the imaging is performed on a separate instrument, it should also be recorded in the Group 1 coupling fields.

semImaging_samplePersistentIdentifier.title: Sample Persistent Identifier
semImaging_samplePersistentIdentifier.description: Globally unique, persistent identifier for each sample listed in Sample Name. IGSN (International Geo Sample Number) is the recommended standard for geological and cosmochemical samples, as used by Astromat, EarthChem and SESAR. Where a sample and its sub-samples are separately registered, record the identifier at the level actually analysed.

semImaging_samplePreparationMethod.title: Sample Preparation Method
semImaging_samplePreparationMethod.description: The form in which the sample is presented to the instrument, and the preparation that brought it to that form — for example mounting, sectioning, polishing, coating, crushing, fusion, or extraction of an electron-transparent section. Record 'None' where the material is analysed as received.

semImaging_samplingUnitSelectionCriteria.title: Sampling Unit Selection Criteria
semImaging_samplingUnitSelectionCriteria.description: The rules governing which sampling unit(s) within a sample are selected for analysis, and why. Covers the criteria applied when choosing grains, aliquots, spots, or a region of interest — size, morphology, clarity, freedom from inclusions or alteration, phase identity, or spatial position. Distinct from Target Material, which states the material type the procedure is designed for, and from Sampling Unit, which names the kind of subdivision one row of reported values corresponds to: this field states how, within such a sample, the unit actually analysed is picked out.

semImaging_workingDistance.title: Working Distance
semImaging_workingDistance.description: Distance between the objective lens pole piece and the specimen surface in millimetres.

sem_acceleratingVoltage.title: Accelerating Voltage
sem_acceleratingVoltage.description: Electron beam accelerating voltage in kilovolts.

sem_analyte.title: Analyte
sem_analyte.description: The chemical species this procedure is designed to determine, recorded at whatever resolution the chemistry is resolved — element(s) for this technique; valence species where a procedure resolves oxidation state; compounds where it resolves molecules. Isotopes are not analytes: isotopes of an element are the same chemical species. The subset actually measured may be narrower than the registered suite where species were excluded due to interferences or scope reduction.

sem_analyteEstimationMethod.title: Analyte Estimation Method
sem_analyteEstimationMethod.description: Whether elemental concentrations were calculated directly from measured X-ray intensities, or estimated by cation stoichiometry (e.g., oxygen calculated from cation proportions in silicates; carbon from stoichiometry in carbonates).

sem_backgroundCountingTime.title: Background Counting Time
sem_backgroundCountingTime.description: Total time spent counting at off-peak background position(s) in seconds, summed across all background positions.

sem_backgroundPosition.title: Background Position(s)
sem_backgroundPosition.description: Location(s) of off-peak background measurement(s) relative to the peak, in mm or sin-theta, and whether on the high- or low-energy side.

sem_beamCurrent.title: Beam Current
sem_beamCurrent.description: Electron beam probe current. For sub-nA values use decimal notation (e.g., 0.4 nA).

sem_beamDamageMinimization.title: Beam Damage Minimization
sem_beamDamageMinimization.description: Describes any measures taken to reduce electron beam damage to the sample during analysis. Examples: reduced accelerating voltage, lowered beam current, defocused or rastered beam, cooled stage, short acquisition sequences, or rotating between multiple points.

sem_beamDiameter.title: Beam Diameter
sem_beamDiameter.description: Nominal electron beam diameter (spot size) at the sample surface, in nanometres or micrometres, as set by the condenser aperture and working distance. For mapping modes, the effective spatial sampling interval is further defined by Step Size / Pixel Size.

sem_beamRasterDimensions.title: Beam Raster Dimensions
sem_beamRasterDimensions.description: Dimensions of the small area over which the beam is rastered at a single analysis point, reported as width × height in µm. Applicable when Beam Mode = Rastered; defines the effective spatial footprint of the measurement. Not applicable when mapping.

sem_blankCorrection.title: Blank Correction
sem_blankCorrection.description: Method and reference material(s) used to determine and subtract blank signal contributions (e.g., carbon coat contribution to C signal, or background contamination for trace elements).

sem_calibrationFactorAndDeterminationMet.title: Calibration Factor and Determination Method
sem_calibrationFactorAndDeterminationMet.description: An externally-calibrated factor that converts the measured quantity into the reported quantity, how it was determined, and its uncertainty. Applies where the conversion depends on a factor calibrated against a reference of independently known value, rather than on the instrument response alone. Distinct from the fields that name the calibration material and that state which approach applies to which analyte, where the technique has them: this field records the resulting factor itself.

sem_chamberPressure.title: Chamber Pressure
sem_chamberPressure.description: Chamber pressure and gas type during analysis. Required for variable pressure (VP-SEM) and environmental SEM (ESEM) modes. Report value and unit (Pa or Torr) and gas composition. Use 'None' for standard high-vacuum operation.

sem_clDetectorConfiguration.title: CL Detector Configuration
sem_clDetectorConfiguration.description: CL detector type, manufacturer, model, collection optics (e.g., parabolic mirror, elliptical mirror, light guide), and spectral detection configuration (PMT for panchromatic, CCD/EMCCD for spectral, multi-channel for pseudo-color CL).

sem_clGrating.title: CL Grating
sem_clGrating.description: Diffraction grating specification for spectral or hyperspectral CL acquisition, including groove density and blaze wavelength. Not applicable to panchromatic-only acquisition.

sem_clIntegrationTime.title: CL Integration Time
sem_clIntegrationTime.description: Acquisition time per pixel (hyperspectral map mode) or per spectrum (spectral point mode), in ms or s.

sem_clWavelengthCalibrationReference.title: CL Wavelength Calibration Reference
sem_clWavelengthCalibrationReference.description: Reference light source or standard material used to calibrate the wavelength axis of the CL spectrometer. Required for quantitative spectral CL and hyperspectral mapping.

sem_coarseMillingConditions.title: Coarse Milling Conditions
sem_coarseMillingConditions.description: Ion beam voltage and current used for bulk material removal during FIB milling. For TEM specimen preparation: bulk trenching to isolate the lamella and intermediate thinning. For 3D tomography: face preparation and initial slice removal.

sem_constantsAndReferenceValuesUsed.title: Constants and Reference Values Used
sem_constantsAndReferenceValuesUsed.description: Physical constants and reference values used in data reduction to calculate the final reported quantity (e.g., decay constants for age calculation, standard isotope ratios, or other citable reference values used in a correction or calculation), together with their source. Distinct from the Group 6 reference-material fields, which document accepted values for specific calibration/validation materials rather than universal physical constants. Record "None" if no citable, revisable physical constants feed into this procedure's data reduction.

sem_coupledDatasetOrPublicationReference.title: Coupled Dataset or Publication Reference
sem_coupledDatasetOrPublicationReference.description: DOI or other persistent identifier for the co-registered dataset or publication where both datasets are reported together. Accepts: a dedicated dataset DOI (if separately deposited), a shared dataset DOI (if co-submitted in the same package), or a publication DOI. Use "same submission" if the coupled dataset is included in this data package, or "pending" if not yet assigned. If coupling is documented through a shared sample identifier only, that information is already captured in Sample Persistent Identifier (Group 2).

sem_coupledProcedureDoi.title: Coupled Procedure DOI
sem_coupledProcedureDoi.description: Registered procedure DOI for the coupled technique named above. If the coupled procedure has not yet been registered, enter the DOI of a publication describing the coupled method, or "pending". Enter "None" if no coupling is planned.

sem_crystalStructureDatabase.title: Crystal Structure Database
sem_crystalStructureDatabase.description: Crystal structure database used for EBSD phase identification and Kikuchi pattern simulation.

sem_dataProcessingSoftware.title: Data Processing Software(s)
sem_dataProcessingSoftware.description: All software applied to the data after acquisition in order to produce the reported quantities, including version numbers. List every package used. Distinct from Acquisition Software, which controls the instrument and collects the raw data.

sem_driftCorrection.title: Drift Correction
sem_driftCorrection.description: Describes whether and how stage or beam drift was monitored and corrected during the measurement session. Examples: periodic stage realignment to a fiducial marker, automated beam drift correction in acquisition software, or reanalysis of a reference point at regular intervals.

sem_dwellTimePerPixel.title: Dwell Time per Pixel
sem_dwellTimePerPixel.description: Time the electron beam dwells on each pixel during raster scanning (imaging modes) or on each step position during compositional mapping (EDS and WDS mapping modes), in microseconds or milliseconds. For WDS mapping, the dwell time is per spectrometer per pixel.

sem_ebsdFrameTime.title: EBSD Frame Time
sem_ebsdFrameTime.description: Acquisition time per EBSD diffraction pattern frame in milliseconds.

sem_ebsdPatternQualityThreshold.title: EBSD Pattern Quality Threshold
sem_ebsdPatternQualityThreshold.description: Minimum pattern quality or confidence index threshold applied during EBSD data processing to exclude unreliably indexed points from orientation maps. Include metric name and threshold value.

sem_ebsdPhaseList.title: EBSD Phase List
sem_ebsdPhaseList.description: Mineral phases included in the EBSD reference pattern library for this procedure. Phases may be added for specific sample compositions beyond the expected suite for the target material.

sem_ebsdStepSize.title: EBSD Step Size
sem_ebsdStepSize.description: Distance between adjacent EBSD measurement points in the map in nm or µm. Must be smaller than the smallest grain of interest.

sem_edsDetectorConfiguration.title: EDS Detector Configuration
sem_edsDetectorConfiguration.description: EDS detector type, manufacturer, number of detector elements, active area and solid angle, window type, and geometry (take-off angle, position). List multiple detectors separately. Record 'N/A' where the procedure has no EDS detector.

sem_edsLiveTimePerPointOrPixel.title: EDS Live Time per Point or Pixel
sem_edsLiveTimePerPointOrPixel.description: EDS spectral acquisition live time per analysis point or per pixel in seconds.

schema:name.const: EDS Live Time per Point or Pixel

sem_edsSpectralProcessingType.title: EDS Spectral Processing Type
sem_edsSpectralProcessingType.description: Method used to process EDS spectra and extract net peak intensities from raw spectral data. Applied before quantification (see Matrix Correction Method). Common approaches include background fitting and subtraction followed by peak integration, and filter fit or Gaussian deconvolution for overlapping peaks.

sem_finePolishingConditions.title: Fine Polishing Conditions
sem_finePolishingConditions.description: Ion beam voltage and current for final thinning and surface polishing of the TEM lamella.

sem_foilThickness.title: Foil Thickness
sem_foilThickness.description: Target thickness of the electron-transparent TEM lamella after final FIB polishing, in nanometres. Actual thickness may differ from target.

sem_halogenCorrectionOnOxygen.title: Halogen Correction on Oxygen
sem_halogenCorrectionOnOxygen.description: Whether oxygen content was adjusted to account for halogen substitution (F and/or Cl replacing OH) in halogen-bearing phases such as apatite, amphibole, and mica, where oxygen is calculated by stoichiometry.

sem_imageRegistration3D.title: 3D Image Registration
sem_imageRegistration3D.description: Method used to align consecutive SEM image slices in the 3D stack to correct for drift, vibration, and curtaining artifacts. Include software used.

sem_interferenceCorrectionStandard.title: Interference Correction Standard
sem_interferenceCorrectionStandard.description: Reference material used to quantify and calibrate the interference correction.

sem_interferingElements.title: Interfering Elements
sem_interferingElements.description: Element(s) whose X-ray lines overlap with the measured peak, requiring a correction.

sem_ionMillingConditions.title: Ion Milling Conditions (3D Tomography)
sem_ionMillingConditions.description: Ion beam voltage and current used to mill each slice during FIB-SEM serial sectioning.

sem_normalizationStandardsBasedCorrectio.title: Normalization / Standards-Based Correction
sem_normalizationStandardsBasedCorrectio.description: Post-acquisition normalization applied to the reported data beyond the primary calibration — for example correction to a reference value derived from secondary reference materials, or correction for a systematic bias those materials reveal. Record 'None' if no additional normalization is applied.

sem_peakCountingTime.title: Peak Counting Time
sem_peakCountingTime.description: Time spent counting X-ray intensity at the peak position, in seconds. Adjustments stay within procedure-defined bounds.

sem_preAnalysisImagingAndScreening.title: Pre-Analysis Imaging and Screening
sem_preAnalysisImagingAndScreening.description: Imaging or other characterisation performed before the measurement in order to select or locate the sampling unit to be analysed, including the technique, instrument and settings used, and how individual analyses are linked back to the images. Distinct from any imaging the procedure performs as its own measurement. Where the imaging is performed on a separate instrument, it should also be recorded in the Group 1 coupling fields.

sem_primaryCalibrationStandardName.title: Primary Calibration Standard Name
sem_primaryCalibrationStandardName.description: Name and reference material identifier of the primary reference material(s) against which the instrument is calibrated — converting raw signal intensities to concentrations, or anchoring an isotope ratio as the bracketing standard or zero-delta reference. Give the material name, its source or supplier, and a citation for the accepted values used. Where calibration instead uses the vendor's stored library or theoretical response factors rather than measured reference materials — 'standardless' or 'semi-quantitative' quantification — record that here, naming the library or model used. 'None' means no calibration was performed at all, which is a different answer.

sem_protectiveCoatingDeposition.title: Protective Coating Deposition
sem_protectiveCoatingDeposition.description: Type and deposition conditions of the protective coating applied to the sample surface before FIB milling. E-beam deposition should be applied as the initial layer. Typical coatings: platinum (Pt) or carbon (C). State material, deposition method, beam conditions, and approximate thickness.

sem_samplePersistentIdentifier.title: Sample Persistent Identifier
sem_samplePersistentIdentifier.description: Globally unique, persistent identifier for each sample listed in Sample Name. IGSN (International Geo Sample Number) is the recommended standard for geological and cosmochemical samples, as used by Astromat, EarthChem and SESAR. Where a sample and its sub-samples are separately registered, record the identifier at the level actually analysed.

sem_samplePreparationMethod.title: Sample Preparation Method
sem_samplePreparationMethod.description: The form in which the sample is presented to the instrument, and the preparation that brought it to that form — for example mounting, sectioning, polishing, coating, crushing, fusion, or extraction of an electron-transparent section. Record 'None' where the material is analysed as received.

sem_samplingUnitSelectionCriteria.title: Sampling Unit Selection Criteria
sem_samplingUnitSelectionCriteria.description: The rules governing which sampling unit(s) within a sample are selected for analysis, and why. Covers the criteria applied when choosing grains, aliquots, spots, or a region of interest — size, morphology, clarity, freedom from inclusions or alteration, phase identity, or spatial position. Distinct from Target Material, which states the material type the procedure is designed for, and from Sampling Unit, which names the kind of subdivision one row of reported values corresponds to: this field states how, within such a sample, the unit actually analysed is picked out.

sem_secondaryReferenceMaterials.title: Secondary Reference Materials
sem_secondaryReferenceMaterials.description: Quality-control reference material(s) measured as unknowns alongside samples to assess accuracy independently and to monitor drift. Give the material name, its source, and a citation for the accepted or reference values used for comparison.

sem_segmentationMethod.title: Segmentation Method
sem_segmentationMethod.description: Method and software used to separate distinct phases or features in the reconstructed 3D volume, turning the grayscale volume into labelled regions.

sem_sequence.title: Sequence
sem_sequence.description: Order in which spectrometer assignments are acquired during point analysis. Not applicable to X-ray mapping, where all assigned spectrometers collect simultaneously at each pixel.

sem_sliceThickness.title: Slice Thickness
sem_sliceThickness.description: Thickness of each FIB-milled slice during serial sectioning in nanometres.

sem_stageScanVsBeamScan.title: Stage Scan vs. Beam Scan
sem_stageScanVsBeamScan.description: For mapping modes, whether the map was acquired by moving the stage while the beam is held fixed (stage scan), or by deflecting the beam across the field while the stage is stationary (beam scan).

sem_stepSizePixelSize.title: Step Size / Pixel Size
sem_stepSizePixelSize.description: Centre-to-centre distance between adjacent measurement points (WDS mapping) or pixels (EDS mapping) in µm.

sem_timeDependentIntensityCorrection.title: Time-Dependent Intensity Correction
sem_timeDependentIntensityCorrection.description: Type of time-dependent intensity (TDI) correction applied to compensate for beam-induced volatilisation or migration of sensitive elements (e.g., Na, K, F in glasses, feldspars, carbonates).

sem_wdsPhaSetting.title: WDS PHA Setting
sem_wdsPhaSetting.description: Pulse height analyzer (PHA) setting for the WDS detector. Integral mode accepts all pulses above a threshold; Differential mode selects a narrow energy window to reject higher-order reflections and escape peaks.

sem_wdsSpectrometerChannel.title: WDS Spectrometer Channel
sem_wdsSpectrometerChannel.description: WDS spectrometer position(s) assigned to each analyte, one entry per assignment. An analyte may be assigned to more than one spectrometer with intensities aggregated (aggregate intensity counting), and one spectrometer serves several analytes across a run, so the assignment — not the analyte — is the unit carrying the spectrometer setup.

sem_wdsSpectrometerConfiguration.title: WDS Spectrometer Configuration
sem_wdsSpectrometerConfiguration.description: Number, type, and crystal range of WDS spectrometers on the instrument. Include manufacturer, model, and crystal range. For SEM-WDS configurations (third-party WDS on a non-EPMA platform), include WDS manufacturer and model.

sem_workingDistance.title: Working Distance
sem_workingDistance.description: Distance between the objective lens pole piece and the specimen surface in millimetres.

sem_xRayBackgroundCorrectionMethod.title: X-ray Background Correction Method
sem_xRayBackgroundCorrectionMethod.description: Method used to estimate and subtract background X-ray intensity beneath the peak. For WDS: typically 2-point off-peak linear interpolation or Mean Atomic Number (MAN) background model. For EDS: spectral background fitting or top-hat filter applied during spectral processing.

solutionMcicpms_analysisSequence.title: Analysis Sequence
solutionMcicpms_analysisSequence.description: The repeating order in which calibration or bracketing standards, quality-control and secondary reference materials, blanks and unknowns are interleaved within a measurement session. Adjustments must maintain the bracketing strategy defined in the procedure.

solutionMcicpms_auxiliaryGasFlowRate.title: Auxiliary Gas Flow Rate
solutionMcicpms_auxiliaryGasFlowRate.description: Flow rate of the intermediate (auxiliary) argon gas stream, between the torch body and the injector tube, which positions the plasma relative to the load coil, in L/min. Distinct from the outer coolant (plasma) gas and from the gas stream that carries sample into the plasma.

solutionMcicpms_calibrationFactorAndDete.title: Calibration Factor and Determination Method
solutionMcicpms_calibrationFactorAndDete.description: An externally-calibrated factor that converts the measured quantity into the reported quantity, how it was determined, and its uncertainty. Applies where the conversion depends on a factor calibrated against a reference of independently known value, rather than on the instrument response alone. Distinct from the fields that name the calibration material and that state which approach applies to which analyte, where the technique has them: this field records the resulting factor itself.

solutionMcicpms_cellExitDiscriminationVo.title: Cell Exit Discrimination Voltage
solutionMcicpms_cellExitDiscriminationVo.description: Bias voltage applied at the collision/reaction cell exit to discriminate between analyte ions and low-energy polyatomic interferences in KED mode, in volts (V). Record 'None' if the cell is in STD mode, and 'N/A' where Collision/Reaction Cell (CRC) Configuration does not include KED or the instrument has no cell.

solutionMcicpms_collisionGasFlowRate.title: Collision Gas Flow Rate
solutionMcicpms_collisionGasFlowRate.description: Flow rate of the collision gas, typically He, introduced into the collision/reaction cell in KED mode, in mL/min. Record 'None' if the cell is in STD mode, and 'N/A' where Collision/Reaction Cell (CRC) Configuration does not include KED or the instrument has no cell.

solutionMcicpms_collisionReactionGasMixt.title: Collision/Reaction Gas Mixture Ratio
solutionMcicpms_collisionReactionGasMixt.description: Where the collision or reaction cell is supplied with a mixture of gases rather than a single gas, the identities and proportions of that mixture. Recorded separately from the gas identity. Record 'N/A' where a single gas is used.

solutionMcicpms_constantsAndReferenceVal.title: Constants and Reference Values Used
solutionMcicpms_constantsAndReferenceVal.description: Physical constants and reference values used in data reduction to calculate the final reported quantity (e.g., decay constants for age calculation, standard isotope ratios, or other citable reference values used in a correction or calculation), together with their source. Distinct from the Group 6 reference-material fields, which document accepted values for specific calibration/validation materials rather than universal physical constants. Record "None" if no citable, revisable physical constants feed into this procedure's data reduction.

solutionMcicpms_coolantGasFlowRate.title: Coolant (Plasma) Gas Flow Rate
solutionMcicpms_coolantGasFlowRate.description: Flow rate of the outer (coolant/plasma) argon gas stream that sustains the ICP plasma, in L/min.

solutionMcicpms_coupledDatasetOrPublicat.title: Coupled Dataset or Publication Reference
solutionMcicpms_coupledDatasetOrPublicat.description: DOI or other persistent identifier for the co-registered dataset or publication where both datasets are reported together. Accepts: a dedicated dataset DOI (if separately deposited), a shared dataset DOI (if co-submitted in the same package), or a publication DOI. Use "same submission" if the coupled dataset is included in this data package, or "pending" if not yet assigned. If coupling is documented through a shared sample identifier only, that information is already captured in Sample Persistent Identifier (Group 2).

solutionMcicpms_coupledProcedureDoi.title: Coupled Procedure DOI
solutionMcicpms_coupledProcedureDoi.description: Registered procedure DOI for the coupled technique named above. If the coupled procedure has not yet been registered, enter the DOI of a publication describing the coupled method, or "pending". Enter "None" if no coupling is planned.

solutionMcicpms_dataProcessingSoftware.title: Data Processing Software(s)
solutionMcicpms_dataProcessingSoftware.description: All software applied to the data after acquisition in order to produce the reported quantities, including version numbers. List every package used. Distinct from Acquisition Software, which controls the instrument and collects the raw data.

solutionMcicpms_desolvationSystem.title: Desolvation System
solutionMcicpms_desolvationSystem.description: Desolvating nebulizer or membrane desolvator used upstream of the plasma to reduce solvent load. Record 'None' if not used.

solutionMcicpms_digestionDuration.title: Digestion Duration
solutionMcicpms_digestionDuration.description: Duration of the primary acid digestion step (hours or days).

solutionMcicpms_digestionTemperature.title: Digestion Temperature
solutionMcicpms_digestionTemperature.description: Temperature at which acid digestion was carried out (°C).

solutionMcicpms_doubleSpikeMixingRatio.title: Double-Spike Mixing Ratio
solutionMcicpms_doubleSpikeMixingRatio.description: Target proportion of double-spike signal relative to total analyte signal in the spiked mixture, expressed as spike fraction (0–1) or spike:sample ratio. The optimum is analyte-system specific and is typically determined using the Double Spike Toolbox or equivalent. The achieved mixing ratio may deviate from the target within acceptable bounds (typically ±20% of optimal); the double-spike inversion corrects for actual mixing ratios. Record 'N/A' where the procedure does not use a double spike.

solutionMcicpms_icpTuning.title: ICP Tuning
solutionMcicpms_icpTuning.description: Description of the approach used to optimise ICP plasma conditions prior to analysis, including the reference material used for tuning and the acceptance criteria (e.g., oxide production threshold, sensitivity targets, mass calibration).

solutionMcicpms_instrumentSensitivity.title: Instrument Sensitivity
solutionMcicpms_instrumentSensitivity.description: Instrument sensitivity achieved in the session, with the isotope or channel it was measured on and the conditions it applies to. May be expressed either as detected signal per unit concentration or per unit mass of analyte delivered — counts per second per ppb, volts per ppm, counts per picogram — or as useful yield, the percentage of sampled atoms ultimately detected as ions, with the method used to derive it cited. A sensitivity the procedure requires before analyses may begin belongs with the tuning acceptance criteria.

solutionMcicpms_instrumentSerialNumberOr.title: Instrument Serial Number or Lab Identifier
solutionMcicpms_instrumentSerialNumberOr.description: Serial number or laboratory-internal identifier for the specific instrument unit.

schema:name.const: Instrument Serial Number or Lab Identifier

solutionMcicpms_instrumentWarmUpSessionD.title: Instrument Warm-up / Session Duration Limit
solutionMcicpms_instrumentWarmUpSessionD.description: Minimum warm-up time required after plasma ignition before analyses begin, and any maximum session duration enforced to maintain stable operating conditions.

solutionMcicpms_integrationTimePerCycle.title: Integration Time per Cycle
solutionMcicpms_integrationTimePerCycle.description: Duration of signal integration per measurement cycle (seconds). Where different isotope channels use different integration schemes, record the time for each channel.

solutionMcicpms_internalStandardConcentr.title: Internal Standard Concentration
solutionMcicpms_internalStandardConcentr.description: Target concentration of internal standard element(s) in all measured solutions (µg/L or ppb). Record 'N/A' where Internal Standard Element is 'None'.

solutionMcicpms_ionCounterDeadTime.title: Ion Counter Dead Time
solutionMcicpms_ionCounterDeadTime.description: Dead time of each ion-counting detector channel, used in the dead-time correction applied to high count rates. Distinct from pulse/analog cross-calibration, which relates the two detector modes rather than correcting counting losses within the pulse-counting mode.

solutionMcicpms_makeUpGasAndFlowRate.title: Make-up Gas and Flow Rate
solutionMcicpms_makeUpGasAndFlowRate.description: Supplementary gas added to the sample-carrying stream between the sample introduction system and the plasma, with its identity and the procedure-registered target flow rate. Record any small nitrogen or hydrogen addition with its own flow, whose unit commonly differs from the make-up flow. Record 'None' explicitly where no supplementary gas is added, to distinguish it from not reported.

solutionMcicpms_massResolutionSetting.title: Mass Resolution Setting
solutionMcicpms_massResolutionSetting.description: Operating mass resolution of the mass analyser. Where the analyser permits selection, state the mode; where individual analytes are assigned to different modes, state each.

solutionMcicpms_memoryEffectMitigation.title: Memory Effect Mitigation
solutionMcicpms_memoryEffectMitigation.description: Procedure applied to identify and minimise carry-over of high-concentration or isotopically distinct material from a preceding measurement into the current one. Mitigation is applied primarily at measurement time, by allowing sufficient washout or rinse between successive introductions. At data processing level, record any flagging or exclusion of measurements where the required washout may not have been achieved.

solutionMcicpms_nebulizerGasFlowRate.title: Nebulizer Gas Flow Rate
solutionMcicpms_nebulizerGasFlowRate.description: Flow rate of the carrier argon gas delivered through the nebulizer (L/min).

solutionMcicpms_normalizationStandardsBa.title: Normalization / Standards-Based Correction
solutionMcicpms_normalizationStandardsBa.description: Post-acquisition normalization applied to the reported data beyond the primary calibration — for example correction to a reference value derived from secondary reference materials, or correction for a systematic bias those materials reveal. Record 'None' if no additional normalization is applied.

solutionMcicpms_numberOfBlocksPerMeasure.title: Number of Blocks per Measurement
solutionMcicpms_numberOfBlocksPerMeasure.description: Number of measurement blocks acquired per sample or standard solution introduction. In MC-ICP-MS, data are structured as blocks of cycles; each block typically begins with a baseline (on-peak zero) measurement before the analytical cycles. Adjust for samples with low signal or where higher precision is required.

solutionMcicpms_numberOfCyclesPerBlock.title: Number of Cycles per Block
solutionMcicpms_numberOfCyclesPerBlock.description: Number of measurement cycles acquired per block. One cycle corresponds to a single set of simultaneous Faraday cup readings integrated for the duration specified in Integration Time per Cycle. Total integration time per sample = (Number of Cycles per Block) × (Integration Time per Cycle) × (Number of Blocks per Measurement).

solutionMcicpms_primaryCalibrationStanda.title: Primary Calibration Standard Name
solutionMcicpms_primaryCalibrationStanda.description: Name and reference material identifier of the primary reference material(s) against which the instrument is calibrated — converting raw signal intensities to concentrations, or anchoring an isotope ratio as the bracketing standard or zero-delta reference. Give the material name, its source or supplier, and a citation for the accepted values used. Where calibration instead uses the vendor's stored library or theoretical response factors rather than measured reference materials — 'standardless' or 'semi-quantitative' quantification — record that here, naming the library or model used. 'None' means no calibration was performed at all, which is a different answer.

solutionMcicpms_reactionGasFlowRate.title: Reaction Gas Flow Rate
solutionMcicpms_reactionGasFlowRate.description: Flow rate of the reactive gas introduced into the dynamic reaction cell (DRC), in mL/min. Record 'None' if DRC mode is not used, and 'N/A' where Collision/Reaction Cell (CRC) Configuration does not include DRC or the instrument has no cell.

solutionMcicpms_reactionGasType.title: Reaction Gas Type
solutionMcicpms_reactionGasType.description: Type of reactive gas introduced into the cell for interference removal through ION-MOLECULE CHEMISTRY, either on-mass or by mass shift. Common reaction gases include NH₃ (e.g., for Fe, Ca, K isotopes), O₂ (e.g., for As, Ge, Te mass shift) and CH₄. The distinction from Collision Gas Type is the mechanism, not the gas: record a gas here when a reaction is intended. Record 'None' if no reactive gas is used, and 'N/A' where Collision/Reaction Cell (CRC) Configuration does not include a reaction mode or the instrument has no cell.

solutionMcicpms_reactionProductIonMassSh.title: Reaction Product Ion / Mass-Shift Transition
solutionMcicpms_reactionProductIonMassSh.description: Where a monitored mass is produced by a reaction in the collision/reaction cell, the precursor ion, the reagent gas and the product ion measured. Records the mass-shift chemistry relating the mass measured to the analyte it reports, which the monitored mass alone does not state. Record 'N/A' where the analyte is measured on its own mass.

solutionMcicpms_rfPower.title: RF Power

solutionSficpms_torchDepth.description: Distance between the load coil and the sampling cone tip (mm), also called injector depth or torch position depending on the instrument manufacturer.

solutionSficpms_torchType.title: Torch Type
solutionSficpms_torchType.description: Type of plasma torch installed (e.g. standard quartz, high-matrix, low-flow).

solutionSficpms_tripleScanningMode.title: Triple Scanning Mode
solutionSficpms_tripleScanningMode.description: Whether each mass peak is scanned three times per cycle and the results averaged (Y/N). Record 'N/A' if not applicable to the instrument.

solutionSficpms_uncertaintyPropagationMe.title: Uncertainty Propagation Method
solutionSficpms_uncertaintyPropagationMe.description: The approach used to propagate analytical uncertainty through the data reduction chain to the final reported value. State which sources are included in the propagation: counting statistics, calibration standard uncertainty, internal standard uncertainty, drift correction, and any systematic contributions. Distinct from Uncertainty Level, which states the convention at which the resulting uncertainty is quoted.

tem_acceleratingVoltage.title: Accelerating Voltage
tem_acceleratingVoltage.description: Electron beam accelerating voltage in kilovolts (kV). Justify any deviation from the standard operating voltage.

tem_analyticalSubMode.title: Analytical Sub-mode
tem_analyticalSubMode.description: Sub-mode(s) of imaging or diffraction performed under this procedure. Multiple values apply when the procedure covers more than one sub-mode within a given analytical mode.

tem_calibrationFactorAndDeterminationMet.title: Calibration Factor and Determination Method
tem_calibrationFactorAndDeterminationMet.description: An externally-calibrated factor that converts the measured quantity into the reported quantity, how it was determined, and its uncertainty. Applies where the conversion depends on a factor calibrated against a reference of independently known value, rather than on the instrument response alone. Distinct from the fields that name the calibration material and that state which approach applies to which analyte, where the technique has them: this field records the resulting factor itself.

tem_cameraLength.title: Camera Length
tem_cameraLength.description: Nominal camera length in millimeters used for diffraction pattern acquisition. Must be calibrated to convert pixel distances to d-spacings. Calibration to absolute d-spacings is required — see 'Diffraction Calibration Reference'.

tem_constantsAndReferenceValuesUsed.title: Constants and Reference Values Used
tem_constantsAndReferenceValuesUsed.description: Physical constants and reference values used in data reduction to calculate the final reported quantity (e.g., decay constants for age calculation, standard isotope ratios, or other citable reference values used in a correction or calculation), together with their source. Distinct from the Group 6 reference-material fields, which document accepted values for specific calibration/validation materials rather than universal physical constants. Record "None" if no citable, revisable physical constants feed into this procedure's data reduction.

tem_coupledDatasetOrPublicationReference.title: Coupled Dataset or Publication Reference
tem_coupledDatasetOrPublicationReference.description: DOI or other persistent identifier for the co-registered dataset or publication where both datasets are reported together. Accepts: a dedicated dataset DOI (if separately deposited), a shared dataset DOI (if co-submitted in the same package), or a publication DOI. Use "same submission" if the coupled dataset is included in this data package, or "pending" if not yet assigned. If coupling is documented through a shared sample identifier only, that information is already captured in Sample Persistent Identifier (Group 2).

tem_coupledProcedureDoi.title: Coupled Procedure DOI
tem_coupledProcedureDoi.description: Registered procedure DOI for the coupled technique named above. If the coupled procedure has not yet been registered, enter the DOI of a publication describing the coupled method, or "pending". Enter "None" if no coupling is planned.

tem_dataProcessingSoftware.title: Data Processing Software(s)
tem_dataProcessingSoftware.description: All software applied to the data after acquisition in order to produce the reported quantities, including version numbers. List every package used. Distinct from Acquisition Software, which controls the instrument and collects the raw data.

tem_diffractionCalibrationReference.title: Diffraction Calibration Reference
tem_diffractionCalibrationReference.description: Reference material or internal standard used to calibrate the electron diffraction camera constant (camera length × electron wavelength), enabling conversion of pixel distances to d-spacings.

tem_diffractionCameraLengthCalibrationMe.title: Diffraction Camera Length Calibration Method
tem_diffractionCameraLengthCalibrationMe.description: Method used to calibrate the camera length constant and convert pixel distances in diffraction patterns to d-spacings or reciprocal lattice vectors.

tem_dwellTimePerPixel.title: Dwell Time per Pixel
tem_dwellTimePerPixel.description: Time spent acquiring signal at each pixel during STEM scanning in milliseconds. For dose-sensitive materials, minimize dwell and compensate with frame averaging. Also governs STEM-EDS and STEM-EELS acquisition where those detectors are used. For 4D-STEM dwell time see '4D-STEM Dwell Time per Probe Position'.

tem_edsAcquisitionMode.title: EDS Acquisition Mode
tem_edsAcquisitionMode.description: Spatial acquisition sub-strategy for EDS measurements: stationary-beam point acquisition, line scan (beam stepped along a transect at defined intervals), or area map / spectrum image (beam rastered over a pixel grid). Specifies how the beam is positioned during data collection within the declared analytical mode. Record 'N/A' where the procedure has no EDS detector. 'Point' covers what the literature also calls spot or point-spectrum analysis. 'Map' and 'Spectrum image' are distinct acquisitions, not synonyms: a map may retain element intensities alone, whereas a spectrum image retains a full spectrum at every pixel and can be requantified afterwards — record which was acquired. Where more than one mode was used, join them with '; ' rather than looking for a combined member.

tem_edsCalibrationStandard.title: EDS Calibration Standard(s)
tem_edsCalibrationStandard.description: Reference material(s) used to validate EDS quantification or determine experimental k-factors or zeta-factors. Record 'N/A' where EDS is not listed in Spectroscopic Detector(s).

tem_edsCountingStatisticsAccumulationCri.title: EDS Counting Statistics / Accumulation Criterion
tem_edsCountingStatisticsAccumulationCri.description: Quality criterion used to determine when sufficient EDS signal has been accumulated for a given pixel or point, in lieu of or in addition to a fixed live time. Expressed as a target relative uncertainty on major-element peak counts achieved by accumulating successive scan frames (e.g., "1% counting statistics on major elements"; ">10% counting statistics"). Distinct from EDS Live Time per Point or Pixel, which records a fixed-duration setting. Record 'N/A' where EDS is not listed in Spectroscopic Detector(s).

tem_edsEnergyRange.title: EDS Energy Range
tem_edsEnergyRange.description: Energy range of EDS spectrum acquisition in keV. Record 'N/A' where EDS is not listed in Spectroscopic Detector(s).

tem_edsLiveTimePerPointOrPixel.title: EDS Live Time per Point or Pixel
tem_edsLiveTimePerPointOrPixel.description: EDS spectral acquisition live time per analysis point (point/line mode) or per pixel (spectrum image) in seconds. Also referred to as "EDS Acquisition Time" in EPMA and some SEM-EDS contexts, where the per-pixel distinction is less relevant. Record 'N/A' where EDS is not listed in Spectroscopic Detector(s).

schema:name.const: EDS Live Time per Point or Pixel

tem_edsSpectralProcessingType.title: EDS Spectral Processing Type
tem_edsSpectralProcessingType.description: Method used to process EDS spectra and extract net peak intensities from raw spectral data. Applied before quantification (EDS Quantification Method). Common approaches include background fitting and subtraction followed by peak integration, and filter fit or Gaussian deconvolution for overlapping peaks. Record 'N/A' where EDS is not listed in Spectroscopic Detector(s).

tem_eelsAcquisitionMode.title: EELS Acquisition Mode
tem_eelsAcquisitionMode.description: Mode of EELS data acquisition. Record 'N/A' where EELS is not listed in Spectroscopic Detector(s).

tem_eelsAcquisitionTimePerSpectrum.title: EELS Acquisition Time per Spectrum
tem_eelsAcquisitionTimePerSpectrum.description: Exposure time per individual EELS spectrum (or per pixel for spectrum images) in seconds. Record 'N/A' where EELS is not listed in Spectroscopic Detector(s).

tem_eelsBackgroundSubtractionMethod.title: EELS Background Subtraction Method
tem_eelsBackgroundSubtractionMethod.description: Method used to subtract the background beneath the ionization edge of interest to extract the net edge signal. Record 'N/A' where EELS is not listed in Spectroscopic Detector(s).

tem_eelsChemicalStateDeterminationMethod.title: EELS Chemical State Determination Method
tem_eelsChemicalStateDeterminationMethod.description: Method used to determine the chemical or oxidation state of an element from the fine structure of its ionization edge (ELNES), together with the reference data or calibration the determination relies on. Name the method family and cite the calibration curve or reference spectra used. Record 'N/A' where no chemical-state determination is made.

tem_eelsEdges.title: EELS Edges
tem_eelsEdges.description: Ionization edge(s) acquired by EELS, specified by element symbol and edge label (e.g., Fe L2,3; O K). Provides the EELS-specific counterpart to the Analyte field: while Analyte lists elements, EELS Edges documents which ionization edges were used and their approximate energy loss positions. The edge list may be narrowed at analysis time. Record 'N/A' where EELS is not listed in Spectroscopic Detector(s).

tem_eelsEnergyCalibration.title: EELS Energy Calibration
tem_eelsEnergyCalibration.description: Method and reference used to calibrate the EELS energy axis. Record 'N/A' where EELS is not listed in Spectroscopic Detector(s).

tem_eelsEnergyDispersion.title: EELS Energy Dispersion
tem_eelsEnergyDispersion.description: Energy dispersion of the EELS spectrometer in eV per channel. Record 'N/A' where EELS is not listed in Spectroscopic Detector(s).

tem_eelsEnergyLossRange.title: EELS Energy Loss Range
tem_eelsEnergyLossRange.description: Energy loss range acquired, defined by onset energy and width in eV. The target range covers the registered analyte edges; the actual range acquired may differ. Record 'N/A' where EELS is not listed in Spectroscopic Detector(s).

tem_eelsEnergyResolution.title: EELS Energy Resolution
tem_eelsEnergyResolution.description: Full-width at half-maximum (FWHM) of the zero-loss peak in eV, measured at operating conditions. Record 'N/A' where EELS is not listed in Spectroscopic Detector(s).

tem_eelsPluralScatteringCorrection.title: EELS Plural Scattering Correction
tem_eelsPluralScatteringCorrection.description: Method applied to correct for multiple inelastic scattering events (plural scattering) that broaden edge fine structure. Record 'N/A' where EELS is not listed in Spectroscopic Detector(s).

tem_eelsSpectrometer.title: EELS Spectrometer
tem_eelsSpectrometer.description: EELS spectrometer manufacturer, model, and key capabilities including post-column GIF model and energy resolution. Record 'N/A' where EELS is not listed in Spectroscopic Detector(s).

tem_eftemEnergyWindow.title: EFTEM Energy Window
tem_eftemEnergyWindow.description: Energy window(s) used for EFTEM elemental mapping: center energy, width, and acquisition method (three-window or jump-ratio). Record 'N/A' where EFTEM is not listed in Analytical Sub-mode.

tem_haadfCollectionAngles.title: HAADF Collection Angles
tem_haadfCollectionAngles.description: Inner and outer collection angles of the HAADF detector in milliradians (mrad). Inner angle can be derived from camera length and detector geometry.

tem_imageProcessingMethodsApplied.title: Image Processing Methods Applied
tem_imageProcessingMethodsApplied.description: Image processing steps applied to TEM or STEM images during or after acquisition. Non-linear processing steps that could affect quantitative interpretation should be documented explicitly.

tem_imagingAndDiffractionDetectors.title: Imaging and Diffraction Detectors
tem_imagingAndDiffractionDetectors.description: List of detectors available and used under this procedure for STEM imaging and TEM/SAED/CBED diffraction recording. Include HAADF/ABF/BF detector geometries and TEM/diffraction camera model.

tem_monochromator.title: Monochromator
tem_monochromator.description: Whether a monochromator is installed and was active during this procedure. Record 'N/A' where EELS is not listed in Spectroscopic Detector(s) and EFTEM is not listed in Analytical Sub-mode.

tem_preAnalysisImagingAndScreening.title: Pre-Analysis Imaging and Screening
tem_preAnalysisImagingAndScreening.description: Imaging or other characterisation performed before the measurement in order to select or locate the sampling unit to be analysed, including the technique, instrument and settings used, and how individual analyses are linked back to the images. Distinct from any imaging the procedure performs as its own measurement. Where the imaging is performed on a separate instrument, it should also be recorded in the Group 1 coupling fields.

tem_precessionAngle.title: Precession Angle
tem_precessionAngle.description: Precession semi-angle in degrees for precession electron diffraction (PED). Not applicable to SAED, CBED, or standard 4D-STEM. Record 'N/A' where Precession ED is not listed in Analytical Sub-mode.

tem_saedPatternSimulationSoftware.title: SAED Pattern Simulation Software
tem_saedPatternSimulationSoftware.description: Software used to simulate electron diffraction patterns for comparison with experimental SAED patterns during phase identification (e.g., SingleCrystal, CrystalMaker, JEMS, DIFPACK). Complements the Acquisition Software field, which covers data collection; simulation software is used at the interpretation and data processing step.

tem_samplePersistentIdentifier.title: Sample Persistent Identifier
tem_samplePersistentIdentifier.description: Globally unique, persistent identifier for each sample listed in Sample Name. IGSN (International Geo Sample Number) is the recommended standard for geological and cosmochemical samples, as used by Astromat, EarthChem and SESAR. Where a sample and its sub-samples are separately registered, record the identifier at the level actually analysed.

tem_samplePreparationDetails.title: Sample Preparation Details
tem_samplePreparationDetails.description: Detailed description of section preparation conditions: FIB milling voltages and currents; final thinning conditions and target foil thickness; protective coating type and deposition method (e.g., e-beam vs. ion-beam Pt or C strip — e-beam deposition causes less surface damage); any post-FIB surface cleanup (e.g., low-energy Ar+ ion polishing in a Fischione NanoMill, final 0.5–2 kV Ga+ thinning); sample transfer and storage environment (ambient air, dry N₂ atmosphere, vacuum transfer holder, glovebox); plasma cleaning before loading. Includes session-specific observations and deviations from the procedure standard. Includes preparation artifacts noted (Ga implantation, amorphization, curtaining).

tem_samplePreparationMethod.title: Sample Preparation Method
tem_samplePreparationMethod.description: The form in which the sample is presented to the instrument, and the preparation that brought it to that form — for example mounting, sectioning, polishing, coating, crushing, fusion, or extraction of an electron-transparent section. Record 'None' where the material is analysed as received.

tem_samplingUnitSelectionCriteria.title: Sampling Unit Selection Criteria
tem_samplingUnitSelectionCriteria.description: The rules governing which sampling unit(s) within a sample are selected for analysis, and why. Covers the criteria applied when choosing grains, aliquots, spots, or a region of interest — size, morphology, clarity, freedom from inclusions or alteration, phase identity, or spatial position. Distinct from Target Material, which states the material type the procedure is designed for, and from Sampling Unit, which names the kind of subdivision one row of reported values corresponds to: this field states how, within such a sample, the unit actually analysed is picked out.

tem_selectedAreaApertureSize.title: Selected-Area Aperture Size
tem_selectedAreaApertureSize.description: Diameter of the selected-area aperture used in SAED mode, defining the specimen region that contributes to the diffraction pattern.

tem_specimenThicknessDeterminationMethod.title: Specimen Thickness Determination Method
tem_specimenThicknessDeterminationMethod.description: Method used to estimate TEM foil thickness.

tem_spectroscopicDetector.title: Spectroscopic Detector(s)
tem_spectroscopicDetector.description: Spectroscopic detectors present and used under this procedure. EDS and EELS parameter fields in Group 4 apply only when the corresponding detector is listed here.

tem_stemDetector4D.title: 4D-STEM Detector
tem_stemDetector4D.description: Direct electron detector used for 4D-STEM data acquisition, recording a full diffraction pattern at each probe position. If a GIF is used as the mounting platform (enabling energy-filtered 4D-STEM), specify this. Record 'N/A' where 4D-STEM is not listed in Analytical Sub-mode.

tem_stemDwellTimePerProbePosition4D.title: 4D-STEM Dwell Time per Probe Position
tem_stemDwellTimePerProbePosition4D.description: Time spent acquiring each diffraction pattern in the 4D-STEM dataset in milliseconds. Record 'N/A' where 4D-STEM is not listed in Analytical Sub-mode.

tem_stemFrameAveraging.title: STEM Frame Averaging
tem_stemFrameAveraging.description: Number of frames averaged (with drift correction if applicable) to produce the final STEM image. Also governs STEM-EDS and STEM-EELS acquisition where those detectors are used.

tem_stemOrientationMappingMethod4D.title: 4D-STEM Orientation Mapping Method
tem_stemOrientationMappingMethod4D.description: Algorithm, software module, and reference crystal structure database used for automated crystal orientation mapping (ACOM) from 4D-STEM datasets. Record 'N/A' where 4D-STEM is not listed in Analytical Sub-mode.

tem_stemProbeCurrent.title: STEM Probe Current
tem_stemProbeCurrent.description: Probe current in picoamperes (pA) or nanoamperes (nA). Also governs STEM-EDS and STEM-EELS acquisition where those detectors are used.

tem_stemProbeDiameter.title: STEM Probe Diameter
tem_stemProbeDiameter.description: Nominal or measured diameter of the focused electron probe at the sample, reported in nm. Related to, but distinct from, Convergence Semi-Angle: the two quantities are connected via aberration coefficients, defocus, and probe current, which are not always published. Report whichever is known; if both are known, report both fields. Also governs STEM-EDS and STEM-EELS acquisition where those detectors are used.

tem_stemScanDimensions.title: STEM Scan Dimensions
tem_stemScanDimensions.description: Number of pixels in the STEM scan frame (X × Y pixels). Also governs STEM-EDS and STEM-EELS acquisition where those detectors are used.

tem_stemScanGridAndArea4D.title: 4D-STEM Scan Grid and Area
tem_stemScanGridAndArea4D.description: Number of probe positions in the 4D-STEM dataset (scan pixels × scan pixels) and the physical area covered. Probe step size is the physical area divided by scan pixel count. Record 'N/A' where 4D-STEM is not listed in Analytical Sub-mode.

tem_temObjectiveAperture.title: TEM Objective Aperture
tem_temObjectiveAperture.description: Objective aperture diameter used to select the imaging beam condition in TEM mode.

vnmir_calibrationFactorAndDeterminationM.title: Calibration Factor and Determination Method

vnmir_calibrationStandards.description: Reference materials measured to calibrate the reported quantity, with source.

vnmir_dataProcessingSoftware.title: Data Processing Software(s)
vnmir_dataProcessingSoftware.description: All software applied to the data after acquisition in order to produce the reported quantities, including version numbers. List every package used. Distinct from Acquisition Software, which controls the instrument and collects the raw data.

vnmir_emissivityMaximum.title: Emissivity Maximum
vnmir_emissivityMaximum.description: Fitted maximum emissivity (Christiansen feature) for this measurement. Record 'N/A' where Measurement Type is not Emissivity.

vnmir_emissivityMaximumFitRegionMaximum.title: Emissivity Maximum Fit Region Maximum
vnmir_emissivityMaximumFitRegionMaximum.description: Long-wavelength limit of the window over which the emissivity maximum is fitted. Record 'N/A' where Measurement Type is not Emissivity.

vnmir_emissivityMaximumFitRegionMinimum.title: Emissivity Maximum Fit Region Minimum
vnmir_emissivityMaximumFitRegionMinimum.description: Short-wavelength limit of the window over which the emissivity maximum is fitted. Record 'N/A' where Measurement Type is not Emissivity.

vnmir_measurementEnvironment.title: Measurement Environment
vnmir_measurementEnvironment.description: Atmosphere the measurement chamber is held in.

vnmir_noiseUncertainty.title: Noise Uncertainty
vnmir_noiseUncertainty.description: Noise-equivalent uncertainty on the reported spectrum for this measurement.

vnmir_phaseAngle.title: Phase Angle
vnmir_phaseAngle.description: Angle between illumination and detection directions, for this measurement.

vnmir_preAnalysisImagingAndScreening.title: Pre-Analysis Imaging and Screening
vnmir_preAnalysisImagingAndScreening.description: Imaging or other characterisation performed before the measurement in order to select or locate the sampling unit to be analysed, including the technique, instrument and settings used, and how individual analyses are linked back to the images. vnmir_spectralResolution.title: Spectral Resolution
vnmir_spectralResolution.description: Instrumental spectral resolution the procedure operates at.

vnmir_spectralSampling.title: Spectral Sampling
vnmir_spectralSampling.description: Spacing between adjacent recorded spectral points. Distinct from resolution: sampling may oversample the instrumental resolution.

vnmir_spotSize.title: Spot Size
vnmir_spotSize.description: Diameter of the analysed area for a point measurement, or the pixel footprint for a map.
